It documents an emerging post-infection complication but does not evaluate any treatment interventions.

Case report describing a single patient with sudden sensorineural hearing loss occurring 3 months after COVID-19 hospitalization. The paper documents a rare post-COVID complication but presents no treatment intervention or comparative analysis.

Case study of an 18-year-old patient with chronic generalized periodontitis and candidal stomatitis following COVID-19 infection, characterized using microbiology and metagenomic analysis. The paper documents oral microbiome composition post-infection but does not evaluate any treatment intervention or focus on long COVID as a systemic condition.

A case report of a 37-year-old male with post-acute COVID-19 syndrome (PACS) treated with neuraltherapeutic medicine (NTM) over 60 days, showing satisfactory clinical improvement at 22-month follow-up. The case highlights potential therapeutic benefits of NTM in managing persistent COVID-19 sequelae, though the authors acknowledge the need for further research to establish effectiveness and safety.

Case report of a long COVID patient who developed COVID-19-associated pulmonary aspergillosis (CAPA) and was treated with posaconazole, a first-line antifungal agent. The patient showed good clinical outcome with antifungal treatment, demonstrating a treatment approach for this post-COVID complication.

A single case study of a 16-year-old boy who developed post-COVID Guillain-Barré syndrome (GBS) and received multidisciplinary physiotherapy rehabilitation including breathing retraining, airway clearance, PNF techniques, and walking programs. Outcome measures showed improvement in functional independence and activities of daily living following the intervention.

This case report describes a 72-year-old patient who developed Guillain-Barré syndrome (GBS) as a post-COVID complication and was treated with intravenous immunoglobulin (IVIG). The case illustrates GBS as a rare neurological manifestation of COVID-19 and documents the patient's clinical course and treatment response.

Case report of a rare post-COVID fungal rhinosinusitis infection caused by Scedosporium apiospermum in an immunocompromised patient. The paper describes clinical presentation and complications but does not study long COVID as the primary focus—it is a case study of secondary infection, not a long COVID intervention trial.

A case report of a young woman in Kenya presenting with end-stage post-COVID-19 pulmonary fibrosis treated with antifibrotic agents and long-term oxygen therapy. The case highlights the clinical presentation and management of post-COVID pulmonary fibrosis, a severe long COVID manifestation.

Case report of a 42-year-old patient who developed cardiac tamponade one month after mild COVID-19 infection, presenting with severe respiratory and renal dysfunction. The paper describes clinical presentation, diagnostic findings, and emergency pericardiocentesis but does not evaluate any treatment intervention.

Clinical case report of a 74-year-old female with adult Still's disease who developed progressive interstitial lung disease and liver failure following SARS-CoV-2 infection. The paper illustrates post-COVID organ damage in autoimmune patients but presents a single case without treatment intervention or control group.

Case report describing successful treatment of post-COVID-19 acute disseminated encephalomyelitis (ADEM) in a 53-year-old woman using high-dose steroids, targeted temperature management, and intravenous immunoglobulin. The patient showed rapid neurological and neuroimaging improvement approximately 3 months after admission, demonstrating the potential benefit of early immunotherapy in severe post-COVID neurological complications.

This is a case report describing rehabilitation and management of post-COVID-19 syndrome in a single patient with severe acute COVID-19 complicated by bilateral pneumonia. The paper presents typical rehabilitation problems and therapeutic approaches for preventing long COVID sequelae but provides no comparative data or structured trial results.

A case report of an elderly woman with dementia and long COVID who received a 3-week telerehabilitation program consisting of active-assisted range of motion exercises. The patient showed improvement in Physical Mobility Scale score (increase of 3 points) after 20 days of treatment.

Case report of a 47-year-old post-COVID patient who developed secondary candidiasis (fungal pneumonia) with severe sepsis after discharge from acute COVID-19 treatment. The patient received anti-fungal treatment with clinical improvement, highlighting the challenge of diagnosing and treating fungal secondary infections in immunosuppressed post-COVID patients.

This case report describes a patient who developed chronic inflammatory demyelinating polyneuropathy (CIDP) following initial Guillain-Barré syndrome after COVID-19 infection. The patient was treated with intravenous immunoglobulin (IVIG) maintenance therapy over six months, with clinical improvement tracked through ferritin levels as a biochemical marker.

This case report describes a 12-year-old child with post-COVID syndrome treated with a rehabilitation program including breathing exercises, muscle strengthening, and aerobic exercise. The intervention showed improvements in subjective symptoms, cardiopulmonary endurance, and quality of life at two-week follow-up.

This paper describes a clinical case of a 63-year-old man with concurrent COVID-19 infection and mental disorder, discussing neurological complications and neuroinflammation from SARS-CoV-2. The case report does not evaluate a treatment intervention or focus on long COVID sequelae, but rather acute neuropsychiatric manifestations during active COVID-19 infection.

Case report of a child with long-COVID-related myocarditis and autonomic dysfunction, demonstrating use of gadolinium-enhanced MRI for diagnosis. The authors developed diagnostic criteria for pediatric autonomic dysfunction and treatment recommendations including behavioral therapy and pharmacological interventions.

A case report of pulmonary rehabilitation in a COVID-19 survivor with morbid obesity who required mechanical ventilation during acute ICU admission. The study focuses on acute post-ICU recovery rather than long COVID (persistent symptoms weeks/months after infection).

Case report describing selective taste control dietary interventions to manage problematic food intake in a long COVID patient with persistent dysgeusia (taste disturbance). The paper documents one patient's experience using taste-based meal modification strategies to address nutrition-related challenges from post-COVID taste dysfunction.

A case report of a severe COVID-19 patient hospitalized for 33 days in the ICU who developed Beau's lines (horizontal grooves on fingernails) 4 months after discharge, despite receiving nutritional therapy during critical illness. The paper documents a post-COVID clinical manifestation but does not evaluate any treatment intervention.

Case report of a 47-year-old man who developed arginine-vasopressin deficiency (central diabetes insipidus) 8 weeks after mild COVID-19, presenting with polydipsia, polyuria, and cognitive symptoms. Patient was treated with oral desmopressin and remained well-controlled at 20-month follow-up, supporting AVP-D as a rare endocrine manifestation of long COVID.

A case report describing a patient who developed systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) one month after COVID-19 infection, presenting with fatigue, malaise, edema, and acute renal failure. The patient was treated with plasmapheresis and immunosuppressants with significant clinical improvement, and the authors discuss plausible mechanisms of COVID-19-induced autoimmune disease development.
A brief case discussion of long COVID and associated pain mechanisms. This is an abstract/editorial piece without original research data or treatment outcomes.

A clinical case report of a 56-year-old patient with long COVID complicated by subacute thyroiditis, pericarditis, and multi-system damage to pulmonary, cardiovascular, and endocrine systems. The case demonstrates the atypical presentation and treatment approach (glucocorticoids and NSAIDs) for COVID-19-induced thyroiditis in the long-term post-infection period.

Case study of a 47-year-old long COVID patient with Alzheimer's disease, documenting clinical improvement (MMSE 23→27) and biomarker status. This is a single case report without intervention testing or treatment evaluation, making it ineligible for the intervention trials meta-analysis.

A case report describing a patient who developed cardiac tamponade and myocardial infarction in the subacute phase after SARS-CoV-2 infection. The paper is primarily about acute COVID-19 complications rather than long COVID, and is a single case report without treatment intervention.

Case report of a COVID-19 survivor who developed early postoperative pneumonia after total hip arthroplasty, suggesting persistent cardiopulmonary effects. Highlights potential long-lasting complications in post-COVID patients undergoing surgery but does not test any treatment intervention.

Case report describing a 9-year-old girl who developed post-COVID myelopathy with lower spastic paraparesis following SARS-CoV-2 infection. The paper documents clinical presentation, diagnostic findings (MRI, ENMG), and neurological examination but does not evaluate any treatment intervention.

Case report describing a rare overlap syndrome of Guillain-Barré syndrome (AMSAN subtype) and acute transverse myelitis occurring as a post-COVID complication in a single patient. No treatment intervention is evaluated; this is a clinical case description of a neurological manifestation of long COVID.

Case report of a 34-year-old male who developed acute quadriplegia due to post-COVID ADEM (acute disseminated encephalomyelitis), treated with high-dose steroids and IVIG. The patient recovered completely over several weeks, demonstrating a rare but treatable neurological manifestation of post-COVID sequelae.

A case report describing a single long COVID patient who developed multiple severe complications including DVT, pulmonary embolism, lung fibrosis, and multiple organ failures during their post-COVID illness course. The paper documents clinical complications rather than evaluating any intervention or treatment, making it a descriptive case study without therapeutic assessment.

Case report of a 59-year-old patient who developed Parkinsonism one week after mild COVID-19 infection and was treated with levodopa. The case documents the post-COVID neurological manifestation and therapeutic response to dopaminergic treatment.

A case study of a 36-year-old female patient with congenital heart disease (PFO) who received hyperbaric oxygen therapy (HBOT) for post-COVID symptoms including dyspnea, reduced exercise tolerance, and cognitive dysfunction. The patient showed clinical improvement after HBOT, including restored stair-climbing ability, reduced breathing difficulties, and normalized vital signs, with no adverse effects reported.

A case-based short review describing a 44-year-old patient who developed acute psychotic symptoms after COVID-19 infection, with a literature review of similar cases. The paper is a narrative review presenting clinical cases rather than a treatment intervention study, and does not evaluate any specific therapeutic intervention.

Case report of a pregnant patient with severe COVID-19 complications including tracheoesophageal fistula, sepsis, and ICU-acquired weakness syndrome requiring five months of rehabilitation. Describes standard intensive care management components including endotracheal tube cuff pressure monitoring, nutritional assessment, antimicrobial therapy, psychiatric screening, and early rehabilitation to minimize complications.

A case report of immune-related peripheral keratopathy in a post-COVID-19 patient who received topical treatment with antibiotics, corticosteroids, and lubricating drops. The patient showed substantial improvement and complete healing within two months, suggesting systemic immune dysregulation post-COVID may affect ocular surface complications.

Case report of a 45-year-old male with small bowel ulceration during acute/chronic COVID-19 infection, presenting with severe gastrointestinal complications including obstruction, perforation, and bleeding. While the paper describes clinical management and treatment outcomes, it focuses on acute COVID-19 complications rather than long COVID syndrome and does not constitute a treatment trial.

A case report describing anti-phospholipid syndrome (APS) diagnosed post-COVID infection, discussing thrombotic complications. The paper focuses on the acute thrombotic manifestations of APS triggered by COVID-19 rather than long COVID syndrome or treatment of long COVID symptoms.

Case report of a 54-year-old male with severe COVID-19 pneumonia complicated by lung fibrosis who received standard COVID treatment (anticoagulation, corticosteroids, oxygen therapy). Imaging showed complete resolution of fibrotic changes and return to normal function at follow-up.

A clinical observation describing treatment of post-COVID cognitive impairment in a young patient, with review of pathogenesis and therapeutic rationale. Demonstrates practical management approach and advocates for further research to establish evidence-based clinical recommendations for post-COVID cognitive disorders.

Case report of a 9-year-old child presenting with acute pancreatitis and multisystemic inflammatory syndrome following SARS-CoV-2 infection. The paper describes clinical and laboratory findings of this single case with favorable outcome, not a treatment trial.

Clinical case report of a 7-month persistent COVID-19 infection with interstitial lung changes in an immunocompromised patient (lymphoma in remission). Treatment included systemic glucocorticosteroids and inhalation surfactant therapy with dynamic monitoring of respiratory function and chest imaging.

This case report describes a 37-year-old woman who developed vasospastic angina and myopericarditis as post-acute COVID-19 complications occurring 1 month after non-severe infection. The patient was successfully treated with amlodipine and isosorbide mononitrate after initial partial response to aspirin and colchicine.

A clinical case report of a patient who developed granulomatosis with polyangiitis (Wegener's granulomatosis) following COVID-19 infection. The paper describes diagnostic challenges and treatment modifications during a long observation period but does not evaluate a specific intervention or treatment strategy.

A clinical case study of a patient with severe aortic stenosis following long-term persistent COVID-19 infection. The paper documents a single patient case with pathological findings of vasculitis and pneumofibrosis but does not evaluate any treatment intervention for long COVID.

Case report of a single patient with post-COVID-19 eosinophilic pneumonia that resolved without systemic corticosteroid therapy, with a literature review of four other reported cases. The paper documents an unusual pulmonary complication of COVID-19 but does not evaluate a treatment intervention or compare outcomes across patients.

Case report of a 25-year-old woman who developed postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome (POTS) three weeks after COVID-19 infection. Low-dose bisoprolol (2.5 mg daily) was markedly effective in reducing standing heart rate and improving symptoms.

Case report of a 44-year-old man with multisystem inflammatory syndrome in adults (MIS-A) occurring 5 weeks post-COVID-19, treated with methylprednisolone, immunoglobulin, and granulocyte-monocyte adsorptive apheresis. While the patient experienced MIS-A symptoms weeks after acute COVID-19, this is a single case report of acute inflammatory disease, not long COVID (persistent post-acute sequelae), and is excluded as a case report without a control group and no systematic treatment evaluation.

This case report describes tacrolimus treatment for a patient with post-COVID-19 interstitial lung disease (ILD) who experienced respiratory failure during corticosteroid tapering. The results show tacrolimus was effective in the post-acute phase but did not prevent progression to pulmonary fibrosis in the late phase.

A case report of a Japanese patient with post-COVID-19 Guillain-Barré syndrome presenting with facial and limb weakness, sensory deficits, and autonomic dysfunction. The patient was treated with systemic management including intubation, intravenous immunoglobulin therapy, and rehabilitation, with clinical improvement noted.

Case report of a 41-year-old patient presenting with acute perimyocarditis 4 weeks post-COVID-19 infection, followed by bilateral facial nerve palsy. Treatment with aspirin, colchicine, and prednisolone resulted in complete improvement of perimyocarditis and gradual improvement of facial nerve palsy.

An autopsy case report of a post-COVID-19 interstitial lung disease patient who experienced acute exacerbation and fatal outcome. Histopathological examination confirmed acute and chronic fibrotic changes characteristic of post-COVID-19 ILD, but this is a single case with no treatment intervention or outcome comparison.

Case report of a 42-year-old woman who developed pulmonary arterial hypertension 6 weeks after COVID-19 infection, diagnosed via right heart catheterization. Patient was treated with phosphodiesterase-5 inhibitor (tadalafil) with clinical improvement, suggesting COVID-19 can cause delayed PAH as a long COVID sequela.

A case report of a 36-year-old male who developed Autoimmune Polyendocrine Syndrome type 2 (APS-2) two months after a mild SARS-CoV-2 infection, with laboratory confirmation of autoimmune Addison's disease and Hashimoto's thyroiditis. Treatment with cortisone acetate and fludrocortisone resulted in clinical improvement, supporting evidence of post-COVID autoimmune manifestations in genetically susceptible individuals.

Case report of a 38-year-old woman who developed biopsy-proven minimal change disease 5 days after acute COVID-19 infection, with spontaneous improvement followed by relapse requiring immunosuppressive therapy. While the paper describes treatment with prednisolone, cyclosporine, and rituximab, it focuses on acute COVID-19-associated nephrotic syndrome rather than long COVID (persistent symptoms weeks to months post-infection).

A case report of a 36-year-old woman with persistent long COVID symptoms lasting nine months, including severe fatigue, panic attacks, and dermatological problems. No treatment intervention was tested; this is a descriptive case report without treatment evaluation.

A case report of a 40-year-old male who developed subacute thyroiditis 5 months after COVID-19 infection, treated with NSAIDs and analgesics without corticosteroids. The patient achieved complete recovery, highlighting thyroiditis as a potential post-COVID complication.

A case report of a 5-year-old child with long COVID following severe COVID-19-related interstitial lung disease, followed up 3 months post-hospitalization. Clinical and imaging assessments showed full recovery with normal spirometry and lung ultrasound findings.

A case report of an 8-year-old child who developed juvenile dermatomyositis with non-Hodgkin's lymphoma following recovery from COVID-19 and MIS-C. The paper documents a rare long-term autoimmune complication but does not evaluate any treatment intervention.

A case report of a 31-year-old woman with long COVID-19 presenting with chronic fever and recurrent cervical cystic lymphadenitis (suspected Kikuchi-Fujimoto disease). Steroid treatment provided temporary improvement, while hydroxychloroquine resolved all symptoms.

A case report of a 58-year-old patient who developed mesenteric vein thrombosis and intestinal perforation as a complication of post-COVID-19 syndrome. The paper presents clinical and imaging findings but does not evaluate or test any treatment intervention—it is a descriptive case report only.

Case report of a 14-year-old girl who developed acute Sydenham chorea 15 days after COVID-19 recovery, diagnosed via neuroimaging and laboratory testing. The patient showed marked improvement following oral anticonvulsant treatment, establishing anticonvulsants as a potential therapeutic approach for post-COVID neurological sequelae.

A case report of a 28-year-old female with post-COVID major depression with psychotic features and Cotard's syndrome who recovered after treatment with sertraline and olanzapine. The paper documents the psychiatric manifestations of long COVID and treatment response in a single patient case.

A case report of a 38-year-old MS patient on rituximab who developed protracted COVID-19 with persistent symptoms (fatigue, myalgia, fever, anosmia) 40 days after initial infection, treated with remdesivir, interferon-beta1b, and dexamethasone. The case illustrates prolonged viral persistence in immunocompromised patients rather than typical post-COVID syndrome.

A case report of a 27-year-old male with long COVID-19 myocarditis presenting with dyspnea, chest pain, and palpitations eight months after mild COVID-19 infection. The patient received pathogenetic treatment with normalization of symptoms after a half-year follow-up period.

Case report of a patient who developed chronic subdural hematoma 2 months after COVID-19 infection, attributed to disseminated intravascular coagulation. The paper discusses the neurological complication of acute COVID-19 rather than long COVID, and presents a single clinical case without treatment intervention.

This case report documents the first pediatric case of acute transverse myelitis occurring after COVID-19 infection in an 11-year-old girl presenting with lower limb paralysis and sensory loss. The patient received multiple treatments including intravenous immunoglobulin, methylprednisolone pulse therapy, and seven sessions of plasma exchange with limited effectiveness.

A case report of acute myeloid leukemia diagnosed 40 days after COVID-19 infection in a 61-year-old patient. The paper describes clinical presentation and workup but does not evaluate any treatment intervention for long COVID.

Case report describing occupational and physical therapy rehabilitation strategies for a COVID-19-associated Guillain-Barré syndrome patient in a long-term acute care hospital setting. The patient successfully regained independence through coordinated OT/PT interventions including manual muscle testing, range of motion exercises, and grip strength training.

This paper describes a single clinical case of a patient with type 2 diabetes who developed hyporeninemic hypoaldosteronism and severe hypotension following COVID-19 infection, treated with fludrocortisone replacement therapy. While the case occurred after COVID-19, it focuses on acute endocrine complications during active disease and recovery, not persistent long COVID symptoms weeks to months post-infection.

This case report describes integrated management of necrotizing periodontal disease as a manifestation of post-COVID syndrome in a 25-year-old woman presenting 11 months after COVID-19 exposure. The patient underwent comprehensive diagnostic workup including imaging, blood tests, and microbial analysis, with final diagnosis attributed to cytokine storm in the oral cavity.

Case report of a 63-year-old man with asthma-COPD syndrome exacerbated after COVID-19 infection, treated with Korean medicine including acupuncture and herbal decoctions. While subjective respiratory symptoms improved, the paper does not focus on long COVID sequelae but rather on post-acute respiratory complication management in a single patient.

A case report describing treatment of post-COVID-19 scalp hyperhidrosis using three different Korean herbal medicines in a single patient. Symptom improvement was documented using validated scales (HDSS and HidroQoL), suggesting potential for herbal medicine in managing this long COVID symptom.

This case report describes a female patient with post-COVID-19 chronic cough and neuropathic pain treated with comprehensive Korean medicine including Chungsangboha-tang, acupuncture, and physical therapy. The patient showed improvement in cough severity, neuropathic pain, and quality of life measures, with no adverse events observed.

A case report describing one patient with functional dyspepsia aggravated by COVID-19 who received Korean medicine treatment. Clinical symptoms improved as measured by GIS, EQ-5D, and NRS scores, suggesting potential benefit of Korean medicine for COVID-19 late complications.

A case report of a patient who developed avascular necrosis of the femoral head and osteoporosis following COVID-19 treatment with corticosteroids. The paper describes a single case with adverse effects but does not test or evaluate a treatment intervention for long COVID.

A case report of a 50-year-old male with post-COVID pulmonary complications treated with modified pulmonary rehabilitation including breathing retraining, airway clearance, and walking programs. The patient showed improvement in functional independence and activities of daily living following the intervention.

A case report of a 64-year-old male with post-COVID interstitial lung disease treated with a combination of prednisone, pirfenidone, and azithromycin. The patient showed significant clinical and radiographic improvement, suggesting combined anti-inflammatory and anti-fibrotic therapy may be effective for COVID-19 related lung fibrosis.

This paper presents a clinical case of a 54-year-old female patient with post-COVID bronchiolitis and severe shortness of breath treated with standard therapy. It is a single case report describing diagnosis and clinical management, not a treatment trial or research study evaluating intervention efficacy.

Case report of abducens nerve palsy and anosmia occurring 8 days after acute SARS-CoV-2 infection in a 69-year-old female. The paper focuses on acute post-viral neurological complications during the infection phase rather than long COVID, and reports spontaneous recovery within 6 weeks without any treatment intervention.

This paper presents a diagnostic case study of a 7-year-old child with multiple organ system involvement following COVID-19 exposure, focusing on differential diagnosis between long COVID and MIS-C. It does not evaluate any treatment intervention, serving instead as a clinical case report for diagnostic education.

A case report describing Korean medicine treatment for a 65-year-old patient with post-COVID-19 pulmonary fibrosis over 25 days. The patient showed clinically meaningful improvement in cough, dyspnea, chest pain, quality of life, and reduced fibrotic lesions on CT imaging.

This case report describes a female patient with post-COVID-19 chronic cough accompanied by neuropathic pain who was treated with Korean medicine including Chungsangboha-tang, acupuncture, and physical therapy. Treatment resulted in improved cough symptoms (CSS and COAT scores), reduced neuropathic pain (NRS), better quality of life (EQ-5D), and decreased inflammatory markers with no adverse events.

Case report describing unilateral hypoglossal nerve palsy occurring 2 weeks after mild COVID-19 in a 64-year-old patient. The patient received rehabilitation and showed improvement, but this is a single case report without a treatment trial or comparison group.

Case report of a 35-year-old woman with type 1 diabetes who developed worsening insulitis and deteriorating glycemic control following acute COVID-19 pneumonia. While the paper discusses COVID-related complications in a diabetic patient, it does not address long COVID (post-acute sequelae) and is a single case report rather than a treatment trial.

This paper presents a clinical case of a long COVID patient with follicular lymphoma who developed pneumocystis pneumonia as a complication. It describes diagnosis and treatment of the opportunistic infection but does not evaluate or test a specific treatment intervention for long COVID itself.

A case report of a 62-year-old COVID-19 patient with severe neurogenic dysphagia treated with pharyngeal electrical stimulation (PES) plus speech therapy. Within 8 days of completing PES, the patient showed significant improvement in swallowing function scores and quality of life, with diet recovery to normal foods within 43 days post-treatment.

Case report of a 69-year-old male with post-COVID cranial nerve impairment (CN VII, IX, X, XII) presenting with oropharyngeal dysphagia, who underwent a 2-month rehabilitation program. The study expands knowledge on late neurological complications after SARS-CoV-2 infection and discusses potential mechanisms of cranial nerve involvement in post-acute dysphagia.

A clinical case study evaluating the efficacy of Calcarea Carbonica 200 (homeopathic remedy) in treating post-COVID syndrome symptoms over a 3-6 month follow-up period. The study assessed treatment response through IgG level measurements before and after homoeopathic intervention.

Case report of a healthcare worker who developed psychiatric symptoms (anxiety, trauma) following COVID-19 hospitalization and was treated with SSRI and NaSSA antidepressants with clinical remission. While it addresses long COVID mental health sequelae and treatment, this is a single case study presented as a case report/editorial rather than a systematic case series.

Case report of a long COVID patient presenting with adjustment disorder in a resource-limited setting. Identifies occupational stressors and social determinants as contributing factors, recommends workplace policy improvements and co-morbid condition management.

This paper describes a single case of Guillain-Barré Syndrome that occurred after acute COVID-19 infection. It does not study long COVID (persistent symptoms weeks to months post-infection) but rather an acute neurological complication during or immediately following the acute infection phase.

A case report of emphysematous gastritis in a COVID-recovered patient, exploring the immunosuppressive effects of COVID-19 as a potential risk factor. The paper demonstrates successful conservative medical management but does not evaluate a systematic treatment intervention.

A case report of a 25-year-old patient who developed rhabdomyolysis and acute kidney injury months after COVID-19 infection, triggered by increased muscle load. The paper documents clinical findings and diagnostic imaging but presents only a single case without treatment evaluation or comparison group.

Case report of a child with post-COVID syndrome presenting with seizures and multisystemic inflammatory syndrome. Discusses proposed mechanisms of COVID-19-induced neurological damage but does not evaluate any treatment or intervention.

This case report describes cardiovascular involvement as a chronic sequel to COVID-19, documenting persistent arrhythmias, myocarditis, and myocardial infarction in the short and medium term post-infection. As a single case report with no treatment intervention or control group, it does not meet criteria for a treatment trial.

Case report of a 43-year-old male with post-COVID-19 immunological disorder presenting with fever, polyarthralgias, and inflammatory markers one month after acute COVID-19 infection. High-dose corticosteroid therapy (methylprednisolone) improved the patient's health, suggesting corticotherapy as a suitable treatment strategy for post-COVID inflammatory syndrome.
Reports a rare case of mandibular osteomyelitis presenting as a possible sequel of COVID-19 infection. This is a descriptive case report without any intervention or treatment study.

This case study describes successful diagnosis and treatment of extended portal vein thrombosis in a post-COVID patient using anticoagulant therapy and percutaneous thrombolysis. The case demonstrates that portal vein thrombosis can occur as a post-COVID complication and highlights the effectiveness of personalized anticoagulation management in treating thrombotic manifestations of post-COVID syndrome.

Case report of acute lower limb ischemia in a recovered COVID-19 patient treated with percutaneous mechanical thrombectomy and catheter-directed thrombolysis. Describes a thromboembolic complication occurring 3 weeks post-infection during acute COVID-19 recovery, not a long COVID intervention study.

Case report of a severe COVID-19 patient who developed post-intensive care syndrome (PICS) during acute hospitalization and underwent rehabilitation. While the patient eventually returned to work, the paper focuses on acute ICU care and immediate post-discharge rehabilitation rather than long COVID specifically.

Case report of a single severe COVID-19 patient followed for 24 months post-infection, monitoring antibody levels against spike protein. Study documents natural antibody persistence without vaccination or reinfection, but does not test or evaluate any treatment intervention.

A case report of a 34-year-old male with post-COVID-19 condition presenting with myofascial pain syndrome of the latissimus dorsi, autonomic dysfunction, and asthenic syndrome. The patient received multidisciplinary treatment including drug therapy, non-drug treatments, and psychological sessions with improvement in quality of life.

Case report of a 15-year-old presenting with abdominal pain and fever one week after COVID-19 infection, diagnosed with multisystem inflammatory syndrome (MIS-C). This is a single case report of acute post-COVID inflammatory syndrome, not a long COVID treatment study.

A case report of a 58-year-old severe COVID-19 patient with deconditioning syndrome treated with active mobilization, breathing exercises, chest physiotherapy, and muscle strengthening exercises. After seven days of rehabilitation, the patient achieved independent ambulation and normal breathing patterns.

This paper presents a clinical case of acute sensorineural hearing loss occurring after COVID-19 infection, hypothesizing a connection to SARS-CoV-2-induced endothelial dysfunction and hypercoagulation. It is a single case report with no treatment intervention or outcomes data, describing a potential long COVID manifestation.

Case report of a 35-year-old patient who developed severe post-COVID peripheral axonal sensory neuropathy requiring readmission 3 days after initial COVID-19 discharge. Patient was successfully treated with corticosteroid pulse therapy, gabapentin, and vitamin supplementation, demonstrating a treatment approach for this rare neurological complication.

A case report describing a single long COVID patient who presented with cognitive fatigue and brain fog and was treated with vestibular physical therapy. The patient demonstrated improvements in cognitive fatigue, brain fog, concentration, balance, and vestibular function.

A case report of a 43-year-old female with post-COVID conditions (PCC) undergoing pain neuroscience education-based physical therapy via telerehabilitation. The patient demonstrated objective improvements in exercise capacity, resting heart rate, and functional measures with high patient satisfaction.

summary: Case report of a 70-year-old woman presenting with pulmonary embolism two weeks after SARS-CoV-2 infection, highlighting the diagnostic challenge of differentiating PE from COVID-19 symptoms. The paper emphasizes the need to consider thromboembolism as a differential diagnosis in post-COVID patients but does not evaluate any treatment intervention.

A case report of a 14-year-old with long COVID and POTS who underwent a six-week blood flow restriction training intervention combined with low-intensity treadmill walking. The patient showed improvements in walking distance, walking speed, sit-to-stand repetitions, and self-reported physical function, suggesting BFR training may be a safe and effective adjunct for improving aerobic capacity in adolescents with long COVID and exertional intolerance.

Personal case report of a long COVID patient who self-administered various treatments over 5 months and documented symptom changes. Author reports temporary improvement in neuropsychiatric symptoms (anxiety, depression, paresthesia, headache) with antihistamine use but notes these are uncontrolled observations from a single case.

Clinical case report describing ocular complications (optic disc congestion) following SARS-CoV-2 infection, attributed to hypercoagulation and microvasculature disruption. No treatment intervention is described or evaluated.

Case report of a young patient who developed central retinal vein branch occlusion with aggressive course following COVID-19, attributed to hypercoagulation syndrome. While the paper mentions post-COVID complications, it is a single case study of an ophthalmologic condition rather than a treatment trial or intervention study.

Clinical case report of cavernous sinus thrombosis occurring after COVID-19 infection, presenting with visual impairment and papilledema. The paper describes a single case and discusses potential hypercoagulability mechanisms post-COVID but does not evaluate any treatment intervention.

This paper describes post-COVID keratitis (corneal inflammation) as an ophthalmological complication of long COVID syndrome, distinguishing it from traditional viral keratitis. The authors report on cases with distinctive features including meibomian gland involvement and superficial corneal inflammation responsive to steroid therapy.

Case report of chorioretinitis caused by Epstein-Barr virus reactivation following COVID-19 infection, presenting with neurochorioretinitis and optic nerve atrophy. Patient received anti-inflammatory and antiviral therapy with slight improvement in visual function over 6 months follow-up.

This case report describes acute disseminated meningoencephalitis (ADME) that developed in a 2-year-old child following COVID-19 infection, focusing on clinical presentation, diagnosis, and treatment of this post-COVID neurological complication. The authors emphasize the immune-mediated pathogenesis of ADME and the importance of early detection and comprehensive treatment to prevent severe neurological complications.

Case report describing a stellate ganglion block procedure as a treatment for long COVID-19 symptoms. Demonstrates symptom alleviation in a patient and suggests the procedure warrants further research for optimizing technique and outcomes.

Case report describing a single patient who developed systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) with vasculitis following COVID-19 infection. The paper discusses autoimmune activation as a possible post-COVID sequela but does not evaluate a treatment intervention.

Clinical case study describing organizing pneumonia as a pulmonary manifestation of post-COVID-19 syndrome, including diagnostic methods and treatment with corticosteroids. Presents a single case with discussion of risk factors and treatment options for post-COVID organizing pneumonia.

Clinical case report of facial nerve neuropathy occurring after COVID-19 infection, describing clinical presentation, diagnostic findings, and treatment outcomes. Discusses the causal relationship between COVID-19 and peripheral nervous system involvement, with facial nerve dysfunction observed in 30% of infected individuals.

This paper describes a case report of a young patient who presented with new-onset diabetes concurrent with acute COVID-19 infection. It does not address long COVID (persistent post-infection symptoms) and presents only a single case without treatment evaluation.

Case report of a patient with post-COVID-19 syndrome treated with medical marijuana, demonstrating symptom improvement. While limited to a single case without control group, it represents an early exploration of cannabis as a potential therapeutic intervention for persistent post-COVID pain.

A case report describing treatment of post-COVID-19 patients with Virlaza™, demonstrating improvements in lung function, mechanics, inflammation markers, and muscle strength. Single-case or small series documentation of therapeutic outcomes in long COVID patients.

A case report of multisystem inflammatory syndrome in adults (MIS-A) occurring 30 days after mild COVID-19 in an unvaccinated individual. While the condition occurs post-COVID, MIS-A is a distinct acute inflammatory complication, not long COVID (persistent symptoms weeks-months later), and this is a single case report without treatment evaluation.

A case report of a 69-year-old patient who developed facial skin necrosis and soft tissue defects following COVID-19 infection, likely due to thrombotic phenomena and vasculitis. The patient underwent successful two-stage necrectomy and free skin grafting with good postoperative recovery, demonstrating management strategies for rare long-term COVID complications.

This paper presents a clinical case of a 27-year-old woman who developed systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) following COVID-19 infection, analyzing the long-term autoimmune effects of COVID-19 on the immune system. It discusses diagnostic challenges and management strategies for COVID-19-triggered autoimmune complications, but does not evaluate or test any specific treatment intervention.

This study evaluates the effectiveness of montelukast, a leukotriene receptor antagonist, as a treatment for long COVID by targeting exuberant immune activation in affected patients. The paper presents a case series of long COVID patients treated with montelukast and reports outcomes related to symptom improvement and immune function.

Clinical case report of a long COVID patient with severe pneumonitis and myocarditis who tested PCR-negative despite active lung and heart involvement. Pulse corticosteroid therapy resulted in disease regression.

Case report of an 18-year-old female with congenital bronchiectasis and Williams-Campbell syndrome who developed severe long COVID. The paper documents clinical presentation and management in a hospital setting, including consideration for lung transplantation, without testing any specific intervention.

Case report examining nephrotic syndrome occurring post-COVID-19 infection. No treatment intervention is tested or evaluated; this is a descriptive case study of renal manifestations following acute infection.

Case report of a patient with Hereditary Hemorrhagic Telangiectasia who developed massive hemorrhagic complications (hypovolemic shock) after SARS-CoV-2 infection, a complication not previously present in their disease course. The paper describes an observed clinical phenomenon linking post-COVID-19 syndrome with increased bleeding risk in HHT patients, without testing or evaluating a specific treatment intervention.

A clinical case report of a young male with post-COVID-19 syndrome presenting with cardiovascular and psychiatric symptoms, autonomic dysregulation, and biochemical abnormalities. The case is presented to illustrate the potential role of bradykinin storm in post-COVID pathogenesis rather than to evaluate a treatment intervention.

Case report series examining whether BNT162b2 mRNA vaccination can prevent or treat neuropsychiatric sequelae in post-acute COVID-19 syndrome patients. The paper presents clinical cases of PASC patients receiving vaccine intervention to assess impact on neuropsychiatric symptoms.

Case report of progressive avascular necrosis in multiple locations with polyarthritis in a young man following severe COVID-19, highlighting the musculoskeletal complications of post-COVID syndrome. The paper documents a clinical manifestation but does not study a treatment intervention or evaluate therapeutic outcomes.

Longitudinal case report of a 55-year-old male with post-COVID myocardial dysfunction monitored over 26 months using serial Multifunction Cardiogram (MCG) assessments. Serial monitoring showed fluctuating ischemia patterns that improved with optimized antihypertensive therapy, hormone dose reduction, and dietary modifications.

This case report describes a 23-year-old male with chronic heart failure and myocarditis 3 weeks after COVID-19 infection, presenting with recurrent hospital admissions. The authors document post-COVID cardiac sequelae but present only a clinical case without testing or evaluating any treatment intervention.

This paper discusses the relationship between COVID-19 and neurodegenerative disease onset, presenting a clinical case of a patient who developed mixed dementia after COVID-19 infection. While it addresses post-COVID syndrome, it is a descriptive case report without an intervention or treatment being tested, making it ineligible as a treatment trial.

A case study describing physical rehabilitation intervention for post-COVID-19 clients, including exercise programming with specific frequency, intensity, duration, and diaphragmatic breathing exercises. The intervention showed significant results in improving physical condition among treated clients.

summary: Case report of a 77-year-old patient with persistent hyponatremia occurring two weeks post-COVID-19 infection with multifactorial etiology. Discusses differential diagnosis and management considerations but presents no treatment intervention or trial data.

Case report of a 25-year-old smoker who developed acute respiratory distress syndrome 25 days after mild COVID-19 infection. The case highlights unusual post-COVID pulmonary sequelae and suggests smokers may be at higher risk for post-infectious lung complications without prior severe infection.

Clinical case report of a child with post-COVID syndrome presenting with vegetative, psycho-emotional, and cognitive disorders. The paper describes symptoms and quality of life assessment using a custom methodology, but does not report on a treatment intervention or trial results.

A case report describing bronchiectasis as an atypical sequela of COVID-19 in a 44-year-old woman who developed this condition two weeks after acute infection. The paper documents the clinical presentation and imaging findings but does not evaluate or test any treatment intervention.

Case report of a post-COVID patient presenting with purulent pericarditis caused by Mycobacterium avium complex and Candida species, managed through both medical and surgical intervention. The paper documents a rare cardiac complication of post-COVID condition but is a single case report without treatment trial data.

A case report describing a single patient who developed a manic episode following SARS-CoV-2 infection, proposing a link between COVID-19 and neuropsychiatric sequelae. The paper calls for further research on psychiatric manifestations of COVID-19 but presents no treatment data or systematic analysis.

This case report describes pulmonary cavitary lesions in a severe COVID-19 patient with long-term respiratory complications, documenting imaging findings of ground glass opacity and fibrotic-like changes. The paper discusses potential treatments (naltrexone, β-blockers, intravenous immunoglobulin) for long COVID symptoms but does not evaluate any intervention in patients.

This paper presents a clinical case of recurrent myocarditis across multiple viral infections (SARS-CoV-1, influenza, SARS-CoV-2) in a single patient, with analysis of post-inflammatory cardiopathy from past epidemics. While the patient did experience cardiac sequelae after COVID-19, the paper is primarily a case report and literature review commentary on myocarditis patterns, not a treatment intervention study.

Single case study of a 57-year-old male with sudden sensorineural hearing loss occurring 2 weeks after post-COVID pneumonia, presenting with pre-existing atherosclerosis and coronary artery disease. The authors propose a mechanistic explanation linking SARS-CoV-2-induced inflammation to cochlear microvascular dysfunction, but this is a descriptive case report with no intervention or treatment evaluation.

Case report of a 60-year-old woman who developed bullous lung cavities following severe COVID-19 pneumonia, with progressive respiratory decline over 2 years including pulmonary hypertension and heart failure. The paper describes clinical presentation and diagnostic findings but does not evaluate any treatment intervention—it is a descriptive case study of a post-COVID complication.

A case study of one 29-year-old male with post-COVID brain fog treated with repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) guided by quantitative EEG analysis. The patient showed improvements in EEG markers (increased alpha band power in frontal region) and self-reported symptom improvement following rTMS treatment.

A case report describing a 68-year-old patient with severe post-COVID complications including diverticular disease, type 2 diabetes, and diabetes insipidus occurring two months after acute COVID-19 hospitalization. The paper discusses clinical features of post-COVID comorbidity but presents no treatment intervention or outcomes data, only diagnostic findings and disease description.

Single-case clinical observation of a 23-year-old female with post-COVID syndrome who received pharmacotherapy (meldonium, ethylmethylhydroxypyridine succinate, meglumine sodium succinate) and showed improvement in neuropsychiatric symptoms and microcirculation parameters measured by bulbar conjunctival angioscopy. The study demonstrates potential treatment efficacy and establishes angioscopy as a diagnostic tool for assessing post-COVID syndrome severity and treatment response.

Literature review examining physiotherapy interventions for post-COVID-19 patients, focusing on breathing exercises and respiratory rehabilitation. A case report describing eight physiotherapy sessions using infrared modality, breathing exercises, and diaphragmatic breathing showing improvements in dyspnea and functional capacity.

A case report describing a single long COVID patient presenting with syncope symptoms, hypothesizing autonomic nervous system disruption as the underlying mechanism. This is a descriptive case report without treatment evaluation or comparison groups.

This paper compares CT imaging findings of disappearing lung syndrome in lymphangioleiomyomatosis versus complicated COVID-19 pneumonia using digital software processing. It is a diagnostic imaging study describing clinical cases rather than a treatment trial, focusing on radiological differentiation techniques without evaluating any intervention.

A case report describing ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction caused by coronary thrombosis in a young patient in the late period after COVID-19 infection, with review of treatment recommendations. This is a single case report, not a treatment trial, and represents acute post-COVID cardiovascular complications rather than long COVID syndrome management.

This case report describes the medical and physiotherapy management of a patient who developed Guillain-Barré syndrome following COVID-19 infection, from acute care through functional recovery. The paper demonstrates the role of physiotherapy interventions in rehabilitation during both acute and post-acute phases of GBS recovery post-infection.

Single-case study documenting a 44-year-old woman with long-COVID responding to moderate and vigorous intensity aerobic and resistance exercise testing over a 4-hour session. The patient tolerated all exercise intensities without severe dyspnea or oxygen desaturation, demonstrating feasibility of graded exercise in long-COVID management.

A clinical case report demonstrating the application of intravenous ozone therapy as part of a rehabilitation program for a post-COVID-19 patient with community-acquired polysegmental pneumonia. The treatment reportedly reduced inflammatory activity and improved physical exercise tolerance and quality of life.

A case study of a 26-year-old woman with post-COVID olfactory dysfunction (parosmia) that progressed to severe depression, treated with a combination of escitalopram, olanzapine, carbamazepine, and psychoeducation. Both depressive and olfactory symptoms showed significant improvement with the integrated biopsychosocial treatment approach.

A case study of a patient who developed depressive disorder following COVID-19 infection. The paper presents clinical observations of post-COVID psychiatric complications but does not evaluate any specific treatment intervention or therapy.

Case presentation of a 19-year-old long COVID patient with asthenia, depression, anxiety, sleep and cognitive difficulties treated with Gliatilin (choline alfoscerate) as part of combination therapy. Demonstrates efficacy and safety of choline-based treatment in managing long COVID symptoms, particularly for patients seeking non-psychotropic interventions.

A case presentation of a long COVID patient with persistent respiratory symptoms, fatigue, and cognitive deficits across multiple hospital admissions. The paper describes clinical features and management of long COVID but does not evaluate or test a specific intervention.

This case study evaluates the effect of modified prone positioning on oxygen saturation in a single long COVID patient at a Jakarta hospital. The intervention successfully improved oxygen saturation, reduced short-term oxygen demand, and improved sleep quality.

Case report of a young female presenting with encephalopathy attributed to asymptomatic COVID-19 infection in the past, discussed as a potential manifestation of long COVID syndrome. The paper describes clinical presentation, diagnostic investigation, and treatment of this single case with literature review.

Case report of a long COVID patient who developed hemoptysis secondary to post-COVID bronchiectatic changes 2 months after initial recovery from COVID-19 pneumonia. Patient was successfully treated with bronchial artery embolization, demonstrating the feasibility of this interventional approach for managing long COVID pulmonary complications.

A case report of a 50-year-old female who developed bilateral abducens nerve palsy two months after SARS-CoV-2 infection, presenting with persistent diplopia. The report supports the hypothesis that COVID-19 can cause post-viral cranial nerve neuropathy but does not evaluate any treatment intervention.

A case study of a 42-year-old woman with long COVID who received 14 hours of exercise physiology coaching over 9 months, incorporating fatigue education, pacing strategies, and wearable biometric monitoring (resting heart rate variability). The patient showed substantial improvements in fatigue (SPHERE-12: 42→4), functional capacity (patient-specific functional scale: 5→19), quality of life (16-item QoL: 54→79), and return-to-work status (4→5 days/week).

This case report describes rehabilitation intervention for an elderly patient with COPD on prolonged mechanical ventilation following COVID-19 infection. While the patient received rehabilitation treatment, the paper focuses on acute post-infection recovery and respiratory weaning rather than long COVID syndrome, which involves persistent symptoms weeks to months after initial infection in otherwise recovering patients.

A case report describing a patient who developed a lupus-pernio-like syndrome following COVID-19 infection, suggesting an autoimmune manifestation of post-COVID-19. This is a single case report with no treatment intervention or control group, therefore not eligible as a treatment trial.

A clinical case report describing an unusual presentation of POTS (Postural Orthostatic Tachycardia Syndrome) that developed in a pregnant woman following severe long COVID-19 infection during the second trimester. The patient continued to suffer from POTS three years after recovery from the infection despite medication.

This case report describes a single patient who developed myocardial infarction without arterial obstruction following acute COVID-19 treatment with ivermectin, hydroxychloroquine, and corticosteroids. The paper attributes the outcome to medication-induced energy deficiency based on Traditional Chinese Medicine principles and homeopathic treatment, rather than studying an intervention for long COVID symptoms.

A case report of myocarditis developing five weeks after acute COVID-19 infection in a 47-year-old patient, presenting with palpitations, shortness of breath, and fever. The patient was treated with cardiac medications (eplerinone, bisoprolol, rivaroxaban, trimetazidine) and showed improvement over four months, demonstrating long-term cardiovascular sequelae of COVID-19.

Case report of a 56-year-old female with genetic predisposition to psychosis who developed schizophrenia following severe COVID-19 infection, illustrating the dual-hit hypothesis. No treatment intervention was tested; the paper documents clinical presentation and theoretical mechanisms of post-COVID psychiatric complications.

Case report of a COVID-19 recovered patient presenting with vitamin B12 deficiency and associated symptoms (weakness, fatigue, dizziness, depression) treated with intramuscular B12 supplementation. The authors propose that vitamin B12 deficiency may occur post-COVID recovery and that supplementation could prevent deterioration in affected patients.

Case report of a 7-year-old girl who developed post-infectious colitis following COVID-19, with gastrointestinal symptoms persisting and worsening over 6 months despite symptomatic treatment. The patient was treated with mesalazine, showing partial improvement but recurring inflammation with elevated calprotectin levels.

This paper describes a clinical case of transient Brugada syndrome appearing on ECG in a patient after COVID-19 infection, with the syndrome reverting to latent form one week later. The authors review similar cases from the literature but do not report results of any treatment intervention or clinical trial.

Case report of axial spondyloarthritis onset in an elderly patient during post-COVID period, describing diagnostic challenges and differential diagnosis. No treatment intervention is evaluated; this is a clinical observation of disease presentation rather than a treatment trial.

This case report documents progressive chronic kidney disease (CKD) in a patient who experienced two consecutive COVID-19 infections, with declining glomerular filtration rate and worsening proteinuria over time. The paper demonstrates potential renal tropism of SARS-CoV-2 and its role in accelerating CKD progression, but presents observational data without any intervention or treatment evaluation.

Clinical case report describing combined post-COVID syndrome in a 10-year-old child, presenting with Multisystem Inflammatory Syndrome in Children (MIS-C) followed by chronic urticarial rash. This is a single case report with no treatment intervention or control group.

A case study of aerobic and strength training intervention in one post-COVID patient over 4 weeks. Lung function (FVC) improved from 79.2% to 94.1% predicted, and 6-minute walking distance increased from 542m to 718m.

A personal narrative by a physical therapist describing her experience with ME/CFS following COVID-19 infection and its impact on her life and career. The paper discusses implications for rehabilitation professionals but presents no empirical data, treatment outcomes, or research findings.

Clinical case report describing pseudomembranous colitis caused by Clostridioides difficile infection in a post-COVID patient, likely secondary to antibiotic use. The paper documents a single case and discusses prevention strategies but does not evaluate a treatment intervention.

A case study evaluating the effects of incentive spirometry respiratory training on a patient with post-COVID-19 and cervical spinal cord injury. The 8-week intervention improved respiratory function parameters (FVC, FEV1, PEF) and quality of life (SF-36 scores).

Case report of a 66-year-old man with COVID-related choroiditis (inflammation of the choroid) occurring in the post-COVID-19 period, initially misdiagnosed as choroidal melanoma. The paper describes clinical and echographic findings but does not evaluate any treatment intervention or therapeutic outcomes.

This case report describes a single patient with Takayasu's arteritis that developed after COVID-19 infection, highlighting novel coronavirus as a potential triggering factor for large vessel vasculitis in post-COVID syndrome. The paper discusses clinical presentation and diagnostic approaches but does not evaluate any specific treatment intervention.

Case report of a long COVID patient with adrenal fatigue treated with functional medicine approach including blood tests, urinary organic acid profiling, lifestyle modification, and oral/intravenous nutrition therapies. Patient demonstrated significant improvement following this functional medicine management protocol.

Case report of two identical twin sisters who experienced non-contact anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) tears approximately 2 months after COVID-19 infection when resuming professional futsal exercise. The authors suggest persistent muscle weakness and ligamentous laxity following COVID-19 increase injury risk and recommend prophylactic rehabilitation programs.

Case report of a 5-year-old child with multisystemic inflammatory syndrome post-COVID (MIS-C) treated with aspirin and prednisolone. The patient recovered well with anti-inflammatory treatment following discharge.

Case report of a post-COVID patient who developed urinary tract mycosis 8 weeks after COVID-19 infection complicated by steroid use and diabetes. This is a single case report describing a rare opportunistic infection rather than a treatment study or intervention trial.

A case report describing a post-COVID-19 patient who developed Guillain-Barré syndrome and was treated with intravenous immunoglobulins (IVIg). The patient showed good clinical response to this intervention.

This case series describes post-COVID-19 cognitive dysfunction in patients and evaluates focused meditation as a therapeutic intervention, using resting-state fMRI to assess changes in default mode network function. The authors report that meditation technique corrected the dysfunctional default mode network and improved patient symptoms.

Case report of a 57-year-old male who developed Guillain-Barré Syndrome two weeks after recovering from COVID-19 infection. The paper documents the clinical presentation and diagnostic findings but does not describe treatment or intervention outcomes.

Case report of a 52-year-old male who developed culture-negative pleural empyema 7 months after mild COVID-19 infection, representing a delayed post-COVID complication. The patient was successfully treated with antibiotics and video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery.

A case report describing the treatment of chronic tension headache and autonomic dysfunction in a post-COVID patient using a multidisciplinary approach combining osteopathic correction, acupuncture, and drug therapy. The authors report high effectiveness of this complex treatment regimen and propose the glymphatic system as a potential mechanism of action for osteopathy in post-COVID patients.

A case report of a mildly infected COVID-19 patient experiencing prolonged symptoms including cough, chest pain, anxiety, and limited physical activity months after initial infection. The paper presents a single case without intervention or treatment outcomes, serving as a descriptive documentation rather than a treatment study.

Case report of a 73-year-old patient who developed plasma cell leukemia with paraneoplastic limbic encephalitis six months after acute COVID-19, presenting with features suggestive of POEMS syndrome. The patient died of respiratory failure related to both the hematologic malignancy and possible long COVID pulmonary involvement, but no treatment intervention or outcome data is provided.

A case report of a 25-year-old female who developed acute psychotic symptoms and suicidal behavior 45 days after COVID-19 infection, treated with haloperidol. The patient achieved full recovery after one month of treatment, representing the first documented case of COVID-19-associated psychotic episode with late psychiatric intervention and complete resolution.

This case report describes a 9-year-old boy who developed post-COVID autonomic dysfunction (POTS) and subsequently drowned during a bathing activity. The case highlights the potential cardiovascular risks of mild autonomic dysfunction in children post-COVID-19 and demonstrates symptom improvement with conservative management over three months.

Case report of an 80-year-old man who developed lupus anticoagulant-hypoprothrombinemia syndrome (LAHPS) with severe bleeding in the post-acute phase after COVID-19. This is a single case report documenting a rare coagulation complication following acute infection, not a treatment intervention study.

Case report of a patient presenting with bilateral simultaneous facial nerve palsy ultimately diagnosed with neuroborreliosis (Borrelia burgdorferi infection) in the context of post-acute COVID-19 syndrome. Antibiotic therapy (14 days) resulted in complete symptom resolution without sequelae, demonstrating successful treatment of this rare neurological complication.

A case report of a 26-year-old postpartum woman who developed Guillain-Barré syndrome following COVID-19 infection and was treated with IVIG. The patient showed clinical improvement after one week of critical care but retained residual quadriparesis and diminished reflexes.

This paper reports a single case of pancytopenia occurring as a consequence of acute COVID-19 infection in a patient presenting to a critical care unit. It does not address long COVID (persistent symptoms weeks to months post-infection) and instead focuses on an acute complication during active COVID-19 illness.

Case report of a non-diabetic patient who developed pulmonary mucormycosis 3 months post-COVID-19, presenting as a long COVID complication. Patient was treated with dual antifungal therapy (liposomal amphotericin B followed by posaconazole) with documented response.

Case report of a 13-year-old boy presenting with acute pancreatitis following COVID-19 infection, treated with homoeopathic remedy Mercurius solubilis. Laboratory markers (serum lipase and amylase) normalized after 45 days of homoeopathic treatment.

This paper presents a clinical case of treating persistent intestinal dysfunction in a COVID-19 convalescence patient using a combination of therapies including bacteriophages, anti-inflammatory agents, and other supportive treatments over an 8-week period. The authors highlight the multisystem consequences of COVID-19 and propose bacteriophage therapy as a less aggressive treatment option for post-COVID gastrointestinal disorders.

Case report of a COVID-19 survivor with empyema thoracis undergoing video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery at high altitude, focusing on anesthetic management of one-lung ventilation in the context of COVID-19 sequelae. The paper describes a single surgical case without evaluating any therapeutic intervention for long COVID symptoms.

Case report of a patient who developed reactive hip arthritis and avascular necrosis 8 weeks after severe COVID-19 pneumonia, treated with NSAIDs and physiotherapy. Includes a literature review of reactive arthritis cases post-COVID-19, but does not focus on long COVID (persistent post-infection syndrome) and is primarily a case report/review rather than a treatment trial.

A case report describing a 35-year-old male with persistent post-COVID anosmia and ageusia following SARS-CoV-2 infection in March 2020, highlighting the role of microbial comorbidities in the persistence of localized post-COVID syndrome. The case illustrates the involvement of microbial factors in prolonged chemosensory dysfunction after COVID-19.

Case report of a patient with chronic oral dysesthesia and dysgeusia post-COVID-19, analyzing salivary dysfunction and reduced histatin-5 levels. Study presents mechanistic insights into oral complications but is a single case without treatment intervention or control group.

Case report of a 35-year-old patient who developed Tietze's syndrome (costochondral inflammation) following asymptomatic COVID-19 infection, presenting with recurrent chest and sternoclavicular pain. Treatment with anti-inflammatory medications and colchicine resulted in uneventful recovery.

A case report of a 72-year-old male presenting with bilateral recurrent exudative pleural effusion 2 months after COVID-19 pneumonia, treated with antibiotics and steroids followed by four aspiration procedures. The patient was monitored for 4 months and achieved clinical improvement with minimal residual pleural effusion.

A case report describing the use of metagenomic next-generation sequencing (mNGS) to detect coinfection with SARS-CoV-2 and influenza A in a long COVID patient with respiratory symptoms. The paper focuses on diagnostic methodology and a single patient's clinical course rather than evaluating a treatment intervention.

This case report describes a 30-year-old patient who developed acute myocardial infarction shortly after asymptomatic COVID-19 infection, without pre-existing cardiovascular risk factors. The paper documents coronary angiography findings showing critical left anterior descending artery stenosis and discusses mechanisms of COVID-19-related cardiovascular damage, but does not focus on long COVID or post-infectious sequelae beyond the acute event.

Genomic analysis of a highly divergent SARS-CoV-2 sample from an HIV+ patient with long-term COVID-19 infection, revealing 89 mutations accumulated over ~2 years including multiple lineage-defining and antibody-evasion mutations. The study provides evidence that persistent infection in immunocompromised patients may be a source of novel variants and highlights the gastrointestinal tract as a potential viral reservoir.

This paper describes endocrine complications associated with COVID-19, including a clinical case of primary adrenal insufficiency that developed after COVID-19 infection. The case presentation discusses diagnostic challenges in distinguishing post-COVID asthenic syndrome from adrenal insufficiency, but presents no systematic treatment evaluation or intervention trial.

Case report of a post-COVID-19 multisystem inflammatory syndrome (MIS-A) patient with renal thrombotic microangiopathy treated with eculizumab (complement inhibitor). The case demonstrates dramatic improvement in renal function with complement blockade, suggesting a potential therapeutic approach for post-COVID inflammatory complications.

Case report describing a patient who developed systemic sclerosis with autoimmune manifestations three weeks after mild COVID-19 infection. The paper documents clinical presentation and autoantibody findings but does not evaluate any treatment intervention or trial design.

Deep immunologic phenotyping study of a single patient with post-COVID Multisystem Inflammatory Syndrome in Adults (MIS-A), examining neutrophil and B-cell dysregulation, autoantibodies, and vascular dysfunction. No treatment intervention tested; mechanistic case report only.

Case report of a 47-year-old male who developed anti-synthetase antibody syndrome and dermatomyositis 4 weeks after COVID-19 infection, presenting with skin rash, muscle weakness, and interstitial lung disease. The paper describes clinical presentation and diagnostic findings suggesting COVID-19 triggered de novo autoimmune myositis, but does not evaluate any treatment intervention.

Case report of a kidney transplant recipient with severe acute COVID-19 followed for 1 year post-discharge. Documents clinical recovery without chronic lung fibrosis or transplant rejection, with immunological assessment showing both cellular and humoral anti-SARS-CoV-2 responses.

This is a case report describing a single patient who developed Acute Macular Neuroretinopathy (AMN) following Influenza A infection during Long COVID, presenting ocular complications and inflammation. The paper does not test or evaluate a specific treatment intervention, making it ineligible for the intervention trials meta-analysis.

Case report of a severe COVID-19 pneumonia patient with persistent post-COVID respiratory symptoms (cough, dyspnea) treated with a 3-month course of oral corticosteroids. Treatment resulted in rapid symptomatic improvement, resolution of pulmonary lesions on imaging, and rapid return to daily activities.

A case report of a 44-year-old male with post-COVID syndrome presenting with severe cognitive and motor fatigue, demonstrating anti-VGLUT2 autoantibodies and treated with IVIG therapy. The paper reports subjective improvement with IVIG, raising a hypothesis about autoimmune mechanisms in post-COVID neurocognitive dysfunction.

Case report describing bullous lung disease as a pulmonary complication of SARS-CoV-2 infection in a post-acute sequelae (long COVID) patient. The paper documents radiological findings but does not evaluate or test any specific treatment or intervention.

A case report of pansclerotic morphea that rapidly developed weeks after COVID-19 infection in a 57-year-old woman with no prior autoimmune disease history. The paper documents the clinical presentation and progression of this dermatologic condition as a potential post-COVID immune-mediated disorder, along with a literature review of similar rheumatologic and dermatologic conditions following SARS-CoV-2 infection.

Case report of an infant with SARS-CoV-2 infection presenting with brief unexplained resolved events (BRUE) and subsequent pulmonary complications. No treatment intervention is evaluated; the paper documents clinical presentation and imaging findings of long-term lung involvement in a pediatric patient.

Case report of a long COVID patient with chronic fatigue, loss of taste, and impaired capillary microcirculation who was treated with BC 007, a DNA aptamer that neutralizes autoantibodies targeting G-protein-coupled receptors. Within 48 hours of treatment, autoantibodies were functionally inactivated and the patient showed improvement in fatigue symptoms, taste, and retinal capillary microcirculation over the 4-week observation period.

Case report of a long COVID patient with SARS-CoV-2 antigen persistence treated with nirmatrelvir/ritonavir and tocilizumab (IL-6 inhibitor), showing symptom improvement with treatment. Demonstrates potential therapeutic benefit of antivirals and IL-6 blockade for long COVID, particularly in patients with persistent viral antigen and autoimmune features.

Case report of monozygotic twins with severe COVID-19, one of whom developed long COVID symptoms 7 months post-infection. Study examines immune profiles and genetic factors associated with severe COVID-19 and long COVID development, but does not test or evaluate any treatment intervention.

Case report of a patient who developed Guillain-Barré syndrome (GBS) following COVID-19 infection, then experienced GBS recurrence after COVID-19 vaccination. Both episodes were successfully treated with intravenous immunoglobulins (IVIg), suggesting a parainfectious/post-COVID autoimmune mechanism with potential vaccine-related triggering in vulnerable patients.

Case report of a patient who developed secondary hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (sHLH) as a late complication of COVID-19 (13 days post-discharge), treated with IVIG and dexamethasone. The case emphasizes the importance of post-COVID surveillance for detecting severe hyperinflammatory complications and associated opportunistic infections.

A case report describing individualized pulsed electromagnetic field (PEMF) therapy applied at C7/T1 in a severely affected Long COVID patient, using Adaptive Force (AF) as a functional diagnostic biomarker. The patient showed immediate improvement in neuromuscular function post-treatment and remained symptom-free at 6 months follow-up.

Case report of a 66-year-old female patient with post-COVID-19 pulmonary fibrosis treated with pirfenidone over 96 weeks. Treatment resulted in improvements in dyspnea level, exercise tolerance, lung function, and quality of life measures, suggesting pirfenidone may be effective for post-COVID pulmonary fibrosis.

A case report of a 63-year-old male who developed opsoclonus-myoclonus syndrome (OMS), a rare neurological disorder, following COVID-19 infection recovery. The patient was successfully treated with intravenous immunoglobulin (IVIG), achieving complete symptom resolution within 4 weeks.

Case report of a patient who developed a Nocardia farcinica cerebral abscess months after mild COVID-19, treated with intravenous and oral antibiotics over 18 months. Highlights immune dysregulation and opportunistic infections as potential PASC complications.

This case report describes a 60-year-old long COVID patient with chronic fatigue and autonomic dysfunction who underwent intestinal permeability assessment using a carbohydrate absorption test, showing elevated lactulose/mannitol ratios during symptom exacerbation and improvement with probiotic therapy (Bacillus coagulans and Bacillus subtilis) and medicinal clay. The study demonstrates a correlation between intestinal permeability alterations and long COVID symptom severity, suggesting microbiome-targeted interventions as a potential therapeutic approach.

Case report of a 23-year-old patient with overlapping long COVID and functional neurological disorder symptoms following asymptomatic SARS-CoV-2 infection. Patient received psychoanalytic psychotherapy and targeted physical therapy, resulting in resolution of dysesthesia and motor symptoms with significant improvement in cognitive complaints.

Case report of a pediatric patient with severe neurological deterioration following COVID-19, treated with rituximab and intravenous immunoglobulin. A novel TLR7 gene variant was identified, suggesting a potential genetic basis for long-COVID neurological complications and proposing TLR7 deficiency as a therapeutic target.

Case report of a 2-year-old with unilateral sixth cranial nerve palsy occurring post-infection as a complication of SARS-CoV-2 infection. The patient showed self-limiting course with full recovery after three and a half months, illustrating post-infectious neurological sequelae in pediatric COVID-19.

A case report of a 4-year-old girl who developed ROHHAD-like syndrome following COVID-19 infection, presenting with central hypoventilation, hypothalamic dysfunction, obesity, and endocrine abnormalities. Treatment with NSAIDs and monthly intravenous immunoglobulin courses led to dramatic clinical improvement.

Case report of a long COVID patient with persistent severe headache who experienced sudden symptom cessation following CGRP monoclonal antibody treatment. Authors propose a protein mimicry mechanism between viral spike protein and CGRP receptors as potential pathophysiology underlying post-COVID headache.

Case report of a patient with paucisymptomatic COVID-19 who developed massive cerebral venous thrombosis and internal iliac vein thrombosis in the late phase of acute infection. While the timing is post-symptom onset, this is a single case of acute thrombotic complication during active COVID-19, not a study of long COVID sequelae or treatments.

Case report of a child with Aicardi-Goutières syndrome who developed post-COVID-19 panniculitis, initially treated with systemic steroids but achieving lasting remission with ruxolitinib (JAK inhibitor). The case explores the role of type I interferon upregulation in post-COVID complications and demonstrates a novel therapeutic approach.
