A case report describing the application of Imagery Rehearsal Therapy (IRT) for treating COVID-related nightmares and post-traumatic symptoms in a 42-year-old long COVID patient admitted to pneumology rehabilitation. The patient showed improvements in nightmare frequency/intensity and sleep quality over a 3-month follow-up period.

A case report of a 72-year-old long COVID patient presenting with depression, brain fog, and cognitive dysfunction nine months post-infection. Treatment with antidepressants combined with non-drug therapies (art, music, drama, dance, movement, physiotherapy, occupational therapy, psychotherapy) resulted in improved depressive symptoms, though memory and concentration difficulties persisted.

Case report describing kratom use in a COVID-19 patient experiencing persistent symptoms including pain, malaise, and fatigue. The patient reported rapid and sustained symptom relief following kratom administration.

This case report describes a 10-week home-based exercise training program in a 67-year-old woman recovering from critical COVID-19 illness. The intervention resulted in substantial improvements in cardiorespiratory fitness, muscle strength, functional capacity, fatigue severity, and self-reported persistent symptoms.

Case study of an integrated primary care and public health approach in Slovenia that implemented multidisciplinary rehabilitation and lifestyle interventions for post-COVID-19 patients. Demonstrates how health promotion centers adapted services during and after the pandemic to address long COVID needs in the community.

This case report describes a 59-year-old female with persistent cognitive dysfunction (forgetfulness, anomia, memory impairment) following mild SARS-CoV-2 infection who received cognitive rehabilitation and citicoline treatment. After six months of treatment, the patient showed marked improvement in cognitive symptoms, suggesting citicoline may be effective for post-COVID neurological syndrome.

This is a case report describing prolonged neurological symptoms in a single post-COVID-19 patient over eight months, with periodic clinical assessments and imaging. The paper documents neurological manifestations but does not study or test any treatment intervention, making it a descriptive case study rather than a treatment trial.

Clinical case study describing a 41-year-old patient with post-COVID-19 syndrome and chronic fatigue, examining hearing and vestibular functions through detailed diagnostic testing. The study found central auditory processing disorders but no peripheral nervous system dysfunction, suggesting cognitive overload as a contributing factor to chronic fatigue.

Case report of a patient with post-COVID-19 syndrome and AIDS presenting with invasive pulmonary cladosporiosis, a rare fungal infection. The study demonstrates the diagnostic challenges of identifying rare fungal pathogens in immunocompromised patients through pathological and molecular approaches.

Case report of a child with post-COVID-19 and cerebral palsy who developed pulmonary tuberculosis as a secondary infection, complicated by immunosuppression from long COVID. The paper describes delayed TB diagnosis and treatment challenges in the context of post-COVID immune exhaustion.

This case series describes a 49-year-old post-COVID patient treated with a naturopathic complex therapy including systemic whole-body hyperthermia, monitoring fatigue, sleep disorders, depression, and overall well-being. The intervention resulted in significant improvements in mental state, physical well-being, and mood, supporting further investigation of multimodal treatment approaches for long COVID.

Case report of a 46-year-old patient who developed mixed polyneuropathy and brain fog syndrome following severe COVID-19 infection. The paper documents neurological sequelae through clinical and electromyography findings but does not test or evaluate any treatment intervention.

Single-cell RNA sequencing study of immune cell populations in peripheral blood of a long COVID patient with pulmonary complications, sampled at 3 months and 2 years post-infection compared to healthy controls. Findings show alterations in immature neutrophil and CD8+ NKT-like cell populations over time, suggesting ongoing immune dysregulation in chronic COVID-19.

Case report of a 21-year-old patient with multisystem inflammatory syndrome in adults (MIS-A) occurring 3 weeks post-COVID-19, presenting with fever, myalgia, and systemic inflammation. Patient was treated with corticosteroids and intravenous immunoglobulins with good clinical response, demonstrating the effectiveness of this treatment approach for post-COVID inflammatory complications.

Literature review examining thrombotic risks and myocardial infarction in children with post-COVID-19 coronary aneurysms, with one case presentation of a 2-year-old boy. The paper focuses on acute post-infection complications (MIS-C, Kawasaki-like disease) rather than long COVID syndrome, which typically emerges weeks to months after acute infection in adults.

This is a case report describing spontaneous pneumo-mediastinum in a post-COVID-19 patient with systemic sclerosis, discussing the overlap of respiratory complications between COVID-19 and SSc-ILD. It does not evaluate any treatment intervention, only presents a clinical observation of a complication.

A case report of severe post-COVID polymyositis in a 7-year-old boy presenting 3 weeks after viral infection, with progression to dysphagia and mechanical ventilation requiring high-dose methylprednisolone and cyclophosphamide treatment. The case demonstrates that aggressive immunosuppressive therapy may be beneficial for severe post-COVID autoimmune complications.

A case report of a 67-year-old post-acute COVID-19 patient who received integrated rehabilitation and nutritional therapy including resistance training, aerobic exercise, and targeted dietary supplementation. The patient showed improvements in nutritional status (BMI, skeletal muscle mass), physical function (grip strength, walking speed), and dyspnea, ultimately returning to work.

Case report of a 14-year-old boy with bilateral uveitis and optic neuritis during acute SARS-CoV-2 infection (MIS-C), treated with local and systemic anti-inflammatory therapy. This describes acute COVID-19 ocular complications, not persistent long COVID sequelae.

Case report of a long COVID patient with secondary hypogammaglobulinemia due to chronic lymphocytic leukemia treated with repeated dosages of COVID-19 convalescent plasma (CCP). Treatment with CCP plus glucocorticosteroids and oxygen led to viral clearance and clinical recovery, with retrospective analysis showing CCP provided time for adequate cellular immune response development.

A case report of a 53-year-old patient with post-COVID pulmonary fibrosis and lung damage treated with photobiomodulation therapy combined with static magnetic field for 45 days. The patient showed improvement in oxygen saturation, pulmonary function, and radiological findings, with complete pulmonary recovery achieved.

A single case report of a patient who developed autoimmune small fiber neuropathy with Sjögren's syndrome following SARS-CoV-2 infection. The paper documents clinical presentation and diagnostic findings but does not evaluate any treatment intervention.

A case report of a 37-year-old woman who developed complex cardiac arrhythmias two months after COVID-19 infection, with diagnostic imaging and monitoring over 3 years showing spontaneous resolution of arrhythmias by year two. The paper does not present an intervention study but rather documents a natural disease course with conservative management only.

Case report of a 77-year-old woman with post-acute COVID-19 syndrome presenting with pericarditis and Takotsubo syndrome. The patient experienced acute kidney injury and fatal cardiac complications despite clinical intervention, illustrating the severe cardiovascular manifestations possible in long COVID.

This case report describes a SARS-CoV-2 isolate from a long-COVID patient persistently positive for ~4 months, documenting novel Spike protein mutations (V143D, del144/145, E484K) associated with immune escape. The study highlights the importance of genomic surveillance in COVID-19 management but does not test any treatment or intervention.

This paper reports a clinical case of a 52-year-old patient with post-COVID-19 Guillain-Barré and acute transverse myelitis overlap syndrome treated with direct transcutaneous electrical nerve stimulation (TENS) combined with plasma exchange and pharmacotherapy. TENS treatment resulted in 89.5% improvement in therapeutic outcomes with significant reduction in neuropathic pain, motor and sensory deficits, and neurophysiological abnormalities.

A case report documenting a single long COVID patient with concurrent dry eye disease, visual asthenia, sleep disturbances, and restless legs syndrome who demonstrated improvement across all symptoms following a six-week multimodal treatment regimen (topical tear substitutes, melatonin, and multivitamin supplement). The case suggests a shared pathophysiological mechanism underlying these manifestations and supports further research into non-invasive treatment strategies for long COVID.

A case study of a 19-year-old with long COVID who met ME/CFS criteria and was treated using ME/CFS management principles including physical therapy, orthostatic testing, and medications for postural tachycardia and mast cell activation. The patient experienced significant symptom improvement over 30 months, demonstrating the potential utility of ME/CFS treatment approaches for long COVID patients.

A case report of a 58-year-old post-COVID patient with persistent dyspnea treated with budesonide and physical therapy, using electrical impedance tomography (EIT) to assess regional lung ventilation before and after treatment. The patient showed subjective improvement in symptoms and objective improvement in ventilation distribution, suggesting EIT may be useful for monitoring post-COVID respiratory function.

A case report of a long COVID patient presenting with fatigue, brain fog, dizziness, and muscle/joint pain, in whom low salivary cortisol levels suggested adrenal dysfunction. The patient was treated with hydrocortisone acetate supplementation, proposing adrenal involvement as a potential mechanism underlying long COVID symptoms.

This paper is a case report and literature review of a patient who developed a spontaneous giant pulmonary hematoma during recovery from COVID-19 infection, requiring hemodynamic support and anticoagulant adjustment. While related to post-COVID sequelae, it is excluded because it is a case report without treatment intervention—it describes a complication and its conservative management rather than testing a specific treatment for long COVID patients.

Case report of a 36-year-old male with post-COVID fatigue diagnosed with late-onset hypogonadism (LOH) showing pituitary atrophy and low testosterone. Treatment with Japanese herbal medicine (hochuekkito followed by juzentaihoto) resulted in improvement of fatigue symptoms, hormonal levels, and LH responsiveness, suggesting herbal therapy may be effective for long COVID-related hypogonadism.

Case report and literature review of internal tremor in a long COVID patient with POTS and small fiber neuropathy, treated with intravenous saline infusions. The authors propose that internal tremor is a manifestation of dysautonomia and small fiber neuropathy driven by hypovolemia, cerebral hypoperfusion, and sympathetic overactivity.

A case report of a 78-year-old patient who died 2 months after severe COVID-19, with autopsy findings of extensive esophageal necrosis and multiple organ thromboses. While the paper discusses post-COVID thrombotic complications, it is a single autopsy case report describing pathological findings in a deceased patient, not a study of treatment or intervention in long COVID patients.

This case study reports on a 64-year-old male with COVID-19-related ischemic stroke who underwent combined physical rehabilitation including conventional therapy, ballistic strength training, high-intensity interval training, and myofascial release. The patient showed significant improvements in gait speed, gait quality, cardiovascular fitness, and functional recovery measures across multiple assessment criteria.

This case report describes a 40-year-old woman with persistent cognitive deficits two years after SARS-CoV-2 infection, with brain PET imaging showing fronto-temporal hypometabolism. The study highlights FDG-PET as a potential biomarker for long COVID-related cognitive dysfunction, but presents only a single case without treatment evaluation.

This paper proposes methodological frameworks and standardized evaluation criteria for assessing long COVID outcomes and their impact on work capacity and social functioning. It focuses on medicolegal assessment protocols rather than testing any specific treatment intervention.

A case report of a 62-year-old female with severe COVID-19 complicated by invasive pulmonary fungal infection (Aspergillus fumigatus) and long COVID syndrome, treated with antifungal therapy, antibiotics, respiratory physiotherapy, and thoracic wedge resection. The case documents treatment outcomes including improvement with combined medical and surgical intervention for long COVID-related pulmonary complications.

Case report of a 40-year-old male with adult-onset Still's disease (AOSD) who developed severe pancytopenia as a long-COVID manifestation following critical SARS-CoV-2 infection. Treatment with high-dose steroids, canakinumab, and epoetin alfa resolved symptoms and stabilized blood counts, suggesting pancytopenia may be a novel long-COVID manifestation in refractory AOSD patients.

Case report of a 20-year-old male who developed severe heterotopic ossification of the left hip following prolonged COVID-19 pneumonia requiring intubation. The paper describes the clinical presentation and discusses HO as a potential long-term complication of severe COVID-19.

A case study of a 36-year-old man with long COVID-associated polyneuropathy followed for two years, examining dynamic changes in autoantibodies (MBP, dsDNA, ssDNA) and cytokines (IFN-γ, IL-1, IL-6, IL-10) via ELISA. The study documents associations between rheumatologic and neurologic markers but does not evaluate any treatment intervention—it is a passive longitudinal case observation documenting immunological mechanisms.

A case report of a 76-year-old oncology patient with persistent SARS-CoV-2 infection (>6 months) treated with Evusheld monoclonal antibodies after sotrovimab failure. The patient achieved viral clearance with Evusheld, allowing resumption of cancer treatment, demonstrating potential efficacy of neutralizing antibodies against prolonged COVID-19.

Case report of an NFκB-deficient patient with persistent SARS-CoV-2 infection who received breast milk from a vaccinated mother as treatment. After treatment, the patient's symptoms improved and tested negative for SARS-CoV-2, suggesting potential therapeutic benefit of breast milk antibodies for persistent infection in immunocompromised patients.

An autopsy case report of a long COVID patient with severe interstitial lung fibrosis complicated by fatal cytomegalovirus and Aspergillus infection. The study documents prolonged SARS-CoV-2 viral persistence and immune dysregulation as risk factors for opportunistic infections in long COVID but presents no treatment intervention or clinical outcomes data.

A case report describing a novel oronasal drainage (OND) treatment for long COVID that targets the epipharyngeal region. The single case documented showed remarkable symptom improvements and enhanced hand blood circulation, though the authors acknowledge the need for further clinical trial validation.

Case report of a 92-year-old patient with SARS-CoV-2 CNS infection who developed persistent neurological symptoms including brain fog and cognitive impairment despite standard medical management. The paper documents clinical progression and emphasizes the need for further research on pathophysiology and optimal treatment, but provides no treatment intervention data or comparative outcomes.

This paper describes a single case report of a COVID-19 infection in a patient with pre-existing interstitial pneumonia and progressive pulmonary fibrosis. It does not study long COVID (post-acute sequelae) or test any treatment intervention, focusing instead on acute COVID-19 complications in a patient with underlying lung disease.

A case report describing a 60-year-old patient who developed esophagitis dissecans superficialis (EDS) following COVID-19, presenting with dysphagia and odynophagia. The patient was successfully treated with high-dose pantoprazole, demonstrating resolution of the post-COVID complication.

This paper presents a clinical case report of myocarditis in a healthcare worker associated with COVID-19 infection, establishing occupational causal relationship. It does not study long COVID (persistent symptoms weeks-months post-infection) but rather acute myocardial complications during active infection, and is a single case report rather than a systematic treatment study.

Case report of telogen effluvium (hair loss) occurring 3-4 months after COVID-19 infection. Presents a single patient case without treatment intervention or control group, documenting a post-COVID symptom manifestation.

Clinical case report of a long COVID patient with COVID-associated limbic encephalitis, presenting detailed diagnosis and three-year retrospective analysis. Describes a stepwise psychopharmacotherapy approach and rehabilitation measures with clinical follow-up outcomes over three years.

A clinical case study demonstrating the use of confocal corneal microscopy to diagnose small fiber neuropathy in a post-COVID syndrome patient. The paper shows the diagnostic utility of this imaging method but does not evaluate any treatment intervention.

Clinical case report of poststreptococcal arthritis developing in a long COVID patient, with literature review of autoimmune complications following COVID-19 infection. No treatment intervention is tested or evaluated; this is a descriptive case with management recommendations only.

A clinical case report describing ophthalmic manifestations (uveitis and posterior segment changes) occurring after COVID-19 infection, possibly triggered by prior vaccination. The paper documents one patient's distant ocular complications but does not test or evaluate any treatment intervention.

Clinical case report describing severe post-COVID pulmonary complications including ARDS, pleural empyema, and histopathological findings in a single patient. No treatment intervention is evaluated; this is a descriptive pathology case without a control group or treatment arm.

This paper reports a single case of Posner Schlossman Syndrome (PSS) occurring after COVID-19 infection in a 54-year-old woman. While temporally related to COVID-19, the paper focuses on ophthalmological diagnosis and management of PSS rather than long COVID as a systemic condition, and presents only one case without treatment intervention data relevant to long COVID research.

This paper discusses clinical manifestations of comorbid cardiovascular and psychiatric pathology in long COVID patients, with focus on adverse drug interactions from medications used to treat COVID-19 and underlying conditions. The paper presents a single clinical case example of a patient on Ritonavir therapy and describes how drug interactions increase cardiac disorder risks in the months following infection, but does not evaluate a specific treatment intervention.

Case report of a 16-year-old COVID-19 survivor who developed new-onset dilated cardiomyopathy one month post-infection, presenting with exhaustion and severe cardiac dysfunction. Treated with a combination of cardiac medications (candesartan, bisoprolol, furosemide, spironolactone, rivaroxaban, trimetazidine) with steady recovery observed at three-month follow-up.

Case report describing a 34-year-old patient who developed new-onset diabetes and Hashimoto's thyroiditis four months after COVID-19 infection, presenting with fatigue, weight loss, and endocrine dysfunction. The patient was treated with insulin therapy and hormone replacement, highlighting post-COVID endocrinopathies as a recognized complication requiring clinical awareness.

Case report of a 42-year-old female who developed atypical Guillain-Barré syndrome 7 days after discharge from hospitalization for COVID-19 pneumonia. Patient was treated with IVIG and required ventilatory support but had a fatal outcome.

A case report of a 60-year-old male who developed pulmonary hypertension as a sequela following severe COVID-19 requiring 56 days of ICU care. The paper describes clinical management but does not study or evaluate any intervention or treatment.

This paper describes a case of secondary hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (sHLH) occurring in a post-COVID-19 patient, attributed to immune system dysregulation. It is a single case report documenting an emerging complication rather than a treatment intervention study.

Case report of a 40-year-old COVID-19 patient who developed acute coronary syndrome one year after initial infection, complicated by fungal infections and avascular necrosis. Describes clinical management with angioplasty but is a single case report without systematic treatment evaluation.

Case report of a 60-year-old female presenting with oral mucormycosis (black fungus) on the palate following COVID-19 recovery. The paper describes clinical findings of this rare post-COVID fungal complication but does not study or evaluate any treatment intervention.

Case report of a 12-year-old female presenting with bilateral facial nerve palsy following SARS-CoV-2 infection, managed conservatively with supportive care. The patient recovered gradually over 4-6 weeks, highlighting facial palsy as a rare post-COVID neurological complication in pediatric patients.

A case report of a young male patient with post-COVID syndrome who received intravenous vitamin C therapy over 13 months. The patient experienced significant improvement and complete resolution of symptoms, including return to full school activity.

A case report of a pediatric patient who developed acute transverse myelitis following COVID-19 infection, treated with pulse corticosteroid therapy. The authors describe clinical presentation, diagnosis, and treatment outcomes in this rare neurological complication of post-COVID syndrome.

Case report of a 38-year-old male with severe COVID-19 pneumonia who developed persistent residual lung abnormalities (PRLAs) at 2-year follow-up, characterized by interstitial opacities and reticular patterns on HRCT without honeycombing. The paper documents radiological findings of long COVID lung sequelae but does not test or evaluate any intervention or treatment.

This is a single case report of a 51-year-old male who developed pulmonary embolism 20 days after mild COVID-19 infection. The paper discusses the potential benefit of extended thromboprophylaxis post-discharge but does not study any treatment intervention in long COVID patients.

This paper presents a case study exploring the application of Buddhist Dharma practices (Guan Yin Citta Dharma Door) as a complementary approach to treating COVID-19 and long COVID sequelae. The study suggests integrating spiritual practices with conventional medical treatment for patient recovery.

Case report of a 55-year-old man who developed Guillain-Barré Syndrome (GBS) weeks after COVID-19 infection, presenting with ascending paralysis and requiring intravenous immunoglobulin treatment. The patient demonstrated good clinical outcome following immunotherapy, illustrating post-infectious neurological complications of COVID-19.

Case report of a 61-year-old woman with post-COVID syndrome presenting with bilateral interstitial pneumonia and second-degree atrioventricular block. Patient was treated with dual antibiotic therapy and pacemaker implantation, with significant clinical improvement.

This paper presents a clinical case of a 52-year-old post-COVID syndrome patient undergoing a 3-week multidisciplinary rehabilitation program that included the medication Cerebrolysin. The patient showed improvement in physical tolerance, cognitive function, and asthenia symptoms, with Cerebrolysin reported to have enhanced recovery effectiveness.

This case report describes a 44-year-old woman with concurrent long COVID and thymoma-associated myasthenia gravis who received a tailored pulmonary rehabilitation program combining light exercise with pyridostigmine medication management. After 4 weeks of training, the patient showed improvements in fatigue and cardiorespiratory endurance as measured by the 6-minute walk test, demonstrating the feasibility of adapted pulmonary rehabilitation for patients with overlapping long COVID and autoimmune conditions.

A case report describing a long COVID patient with persistent tachycardia treated with ivabradine, with myocarditis confirmed by cardiac MRI. The case illustrates a potential cardiac mechanism in post-COVID syndrome and documents treatment response.

This paper describes a clinical case of newly diagnosed severe asthma in a 35-year-old patient following COVID-19, presenting as a manifestation of post-COVID syndrome. The patient showed improvement with biological therapy (genetically engineered biological agent) after failing conventional triple inhaled therapy, demonstrating treatment response in post-COVID asthma.

Single case report of a patient with severe post-COVID syndrome (bilateral lung damage) undergoing 21-day rehabilitation at a climatic resort in Crimea, using climatotherapy, exercise, and physiotherapy. Treatment resulted in improved exercise tolerance, reduced dyspnea, improved spirographic parameters, and 30% increase in lung diffusion capacity.

Case report of microscopic polyangiitis (MPA) diagnosed in a 67-year-old woman following COVID-19 infection, complicated by initial misdiagnosis as chronic kidney disease. The paper presents clinical features and discusses the importance of healthcare provider awareness of autoimmune vasculitis as a post-COVID complication, based on survey data from 21 countries.

This paper reports a case of a long COVID patient treated with the ezrin peptide RepG3, which resulted in symptom alleviation and reduction of proinflammatory cytokines to normal levels. The authors propose a mechanistic explanation involving enhancement of RANTES/CCL5 expression and simultaneous inhibition of proinflammatory cytokines.

A case report describing chronic pain as a neurological manifestation following COVID-19 infection. The paper documents a single or small series of cases presenting with post-COVID pain symptoms without testing a specific intervention or treatment.

Case report of an 11-year-old boy who developed post-COVID tubulointerstitial nephritis and uveitis (TINU) syndrome 2 weeks after COVID-19 recovery. Treatment with steroid therapy showed good response for nephritis with long-term remission, though uveitis response was less robust.

Case report of a 79-year-old woman who developed alopecia universalis one month after COVID-19 recovery and was treated with topical, intralesional, and systemic corticosteroids over 10 months. Hair loss recurred 3 months after treatment discontinuation, demonstrating the relapsing nature of post-COVID-19 autoimmune hair loss and highlighting the need for long-term maintenance therapy strategies.

Case report of an 11-year-old boy presenting with post-COVID-19 neurological syndrome featuring cerebellar ataxia, polyneuritis, and facial nerve paresis weeks after acute infection. Patient treated with antibiotics and immunoglobulins with significant clinical improvement.

Case report of a 48-year-old male who developed late-onset pneumothorax with infected bullae three weeks after recovering from severe COVID-19 pneumonia with ARDS. The patient was treated with chest tube placement and antibiotics (piperacilin/tazobactam and amikacin) and showed clinical improvement.

This paper presents a clinical case of a patient with concurrent chronic neuroborreliosis and post-COVID-19 syndrome affecting the nervous and muscular systems. It is a single case report documenting clinical manifestations rather than a treatment trial or intervention study.

Case report describing post-COVID-19 encephalitis and seizures in a child with a de novo SCN1A mutation (Dravet syndrome), diagnosed after asymptomatic SARS-CoV-2 infection. No intervention or treatment is evaluated; the paper documents clinical presentation, diagnostic findings (MRI, EEG, lumbar puncture), and confirmation of post-COVID encephalopathy through imaging and serology.

A case report describing the use of a Ginkgo biloba extract containing plasmalogen for treating brain fog in long COVID patients. The authors report improvement in a patient with brain fog symptoms, suggesting potential efficacy of this botanical intervention for cognitive dysfunction in long COVID.

Case report of a 27-year-old patient who developed spontaneous pneumothorax during acute COVID-19 infection, with no CT findings at initial presentation. The paper describes radiological findings during acute infection, not long COVID sequelae or any treatment intervention.

Case report of a 54-year-old woman who developed urticarial vasculitis (UV) following COVID-19 infection and was treated with colchicine 0.5 mg twice daily for 2 months. The treatment reduced clinical symptoms and achieved remission, with prior COVID-19 identified as the likely etiological factor.

A case report of a 63-year-old female with post-COVID-19 transverse myelitis presenting with paraplegia and autonomic symptoms, treated with methylprednisolone and plasmapheresis (which the patient could not tolerate). The patient ultimately died from respiratory failure, highlighting the severity of this rare post-COVID neurological complication and the need for further research into effective treatment mechanisms.

This is a case report and literature review of a single patient who developed unilateral vocal cord paralysis 11 weeks after COVID-19 infection. The paper describes clinical presentation, diagnostic findings, and spontaneous recovery without intervention—it does not evaluate or test any specific treatment.

A case report of pulmonary embolism occurring in a post-COVID-19 patient during the acute recovery phase. The paper documents a single clinical case and calls for future clinical trials on thromboprophylaxis duration and dosing, but itself contains no treatment intervention or trial data.

Case study of a 29-year-old male with post-COVID syndrome presenting with cognitive and psychiatric symptoms alongside long-term psoriasis. No treatment intervention is tested or evaluated; this is a clinical observation of symptom presentation in a single patient.

This case report documents lung fibrosis findings in a patient after recovery from acute COVID-19, examining clinical symptoms, chest imaging, spirometry, and blood gas analysis. It is a descriptive case series without any treatment intervention, making it ineligible for the intervention trials dataset.

Case report of a 23-year-old athlete presenting with rhythm and conduction disturbances following moderate COVID-19 infection, complicated by focal myocarditis detected on MRI. The study documents cardiac complications in the post-COVID period but does not evaluate any treatment intervention.

A clinical case report of a 73-year-old male patient who developed thrombotic complications (right atrial thrombus, deep vein thrombosis, and bilateral pulmonary embolism) 53 days after acute COVID-19 infection, presenting as long-lasting post-COVID sequelae. The patient was treated with systemic fibrinolysis, which was tolerated without complications, demonstrating successful management of severe thrombotic complications in the post-acute COVID period.

Case report of a 27-year-old male who developed post-COVID-19 monoarthritis 5 days after SARS-CoV-2 infection, treated with physiotherapy and anti-inflammatory drugs, resolving within 52 days. Review of 8 published cases confirms that SARS-CoV-2 can trigger reactive arthritis in male patients, typically responding to NSAIDs and corticosteroids.

A case report describing a long COVID patient who recovered from all PASC symptoms after a 7-day course of acyclovir prescribed for shingles. The authors propose acyclovir as a potential treatment for long COVID patients, particularly those with herpesvirus reactivation, based on this single case of complete symptom resolution.

Literature review of acute transverse myelitis (ATM) cases associated with COVID-19 infection and vaccination, covering 60 post-infection cases and 23 post-vaccination cases from 2020-2022. While the paper reports treatment outcomes (steroids, plasmapheresis, IVIG), it is a literature review of acute complications during active infection or immediate post-vaccination, not a study of long COVID interventions.

Case report of a 21-year-old male with severe post-COVID fatigue and brain fog treated with Kampo (traditional Japanese herbal) medicine over a 4-month period. The patient showed improvement in symptoms and was able to return to work by December, demonstrating the potential of Kampo therapy for post-COVID condition management.

Case report of a sickle cell disease patient with moderate COVID-19 infection followed for 6 months post-infection, documenting hematological alterations including increased reticulocyte frequency and elevated creatinine and D-dimer levels. The study provides descriptive clinical findings without testing any intervention or treatment.

Case report of a patient recovering from COVID-19 who developed secondary organizing pneumonia (SOP) with persistent respiratory symptoms and radiographic infiltrations, treated with intravenous methylprednisolone followed by oral prednisolone tapering over 6 months. Corticosteroid treatment led to resolution of symptoms and pneumonic infiltrations, demonstrating a potential treatment approach for persistent post-COVID respiratory complications.

This abstract reports on N115 (sodium pyruvate nasal spray) treatment evaluation in COVID-19 long hauler patients experiencing respiratory symptoms and hypoxemia. The authors observed improvements in oxygen saturation levels, breathing difficulty, and headaches, suggesting N115 as a potential therapeutic option.

Case report of a 78-year-old post-COVID-19 patient presenting with painful erosive oral lesions treated with topical vitamin E, nystatin, and artificial saliva. Treatment resulted in complete repair of lesions within 14 days, demonstrating clinical management of an oral manifestation of long COVID.

Case report of a 76-year-old man presenting with subclinical pericarditis (pericardial inflammation without significant symptoms) detected 10+ days after acute COVID-19 infection via ECG findings. The case demonstrates a rare long COVID cardiac complication that resolved spontaneously within one month, highlighting the need for cardiac monitoring in post-COVID outpatients.

This case report describes an 8-month-old infant with post-COVID-19 paediatric multisystemic inflammatory syndrome (PMIS) presenting 3 months after acute infection. The patient was treated with intravenous immunoglobulin, oral prednisolone, and aspirin, with significant symptom improvement within 72 hours.

A case report of a 69-year-old woman who developed opsoclonus-myoclonus syndrome as an immunological sequela of COVID-19. The patient showed partial response to steroids and intravenous immunoglobulin but significantly improved with plasmapheresis treatment.

A case report describing a 45-year-old woman who developed severe gastritis, dysplasia, and food intolerances as long COVID manifestations following SARS-CoV-2 infection. The authors hypothesize that SARS-CoV-2 may trigger disruption of gastric mucosa homeostasis and discuss potential molecular mimicry mechanisms, but present no treatment intervention or trial data.

Case report of a 31-year-old male presenting with chest pain and dyspnea during post-COVID syndrome, initially suspected as myopericarditis but diagnosed with an unstable coronary lesion. The paper describes clinical evaluation and treatment of a single patient case, not a treatment trial or comparative study.

A case report of a 29-year-old patient presenting eight weeks post-COVID with pneumothorax and pulmonary arterial thrombosis, treated with low molecular weight heparin anticoagulation. The large pneumatocele showed significant resolution after three months, demonstrating the role of anticoagulation in managing late-onset vascular complications of post-COVID syndrome.

Case report of a 48-year-old dialysis patient who developed systemic vasculitis three months after COVID-19 infection, presenting with urticarial rash, abdominal pain, brachial plexopathy, and alveolar hemorrhage. Patient was treated with intravenous methylprednisolone, plasma exchange, oral prednisone, and cyclophosphamide, with clinical improvement after two months.

Case report of a patient presenting with Guillain-Barré syndrome (GBS) during acute COVID-19 infection. The paper documents a single case treated with intravenous immunoglobulin but does not address long COVID or persistent post-infection sequelae.

This paper reports a single case of a young female who developed tuberculosis following COVID-19 infection, highlighting immunosuppression as a post-COVID sequela. It is a case report of one patient, not a treatment study or systematic case series.

Case report of a 20-year-old with post-COVID acute cerebellar ataxia and myoclonus (ACAM) treated with IV methylprednisolone, Rituximab, and antiepileptic medications. Patient showed resolution of myoclonus and ataxia within 40 days with PET-CT evidence of metabolic improvement, though residual psychiatric symptoms persisted.

A case report describing a patient presenting with severe neuropathic pain in the lower extremities following asymptomatic COVID-19 infection. The paper documents clinical presentation of post-COVID neurological syndrome but does not evaluate any treatment intervention.

A case report describing a long COVID patient with persistent cutaneous manifestations (chilblains/COVID toe) and peripheral arterial disease treated with oral coumarin anticoagulant therapy. The treatment resulted in marked improvement of swelling, discoloration, and claudication pain, demonstrating the potential role of anticoagulation in managing post-COVID vascular complications.

This is a case report of an 82-year-old male who developed Harlequin syndrome (rare autonomic disorder with hemifacial redness and flushing) following COVID-19 infection, with 10 recurrent episodes. The authors propose post-COVID-19 inflammation and dysautonomic sympathetic fiber changes as a potential pathophysiological mechanism, but present no intervention or treatment evaluation.

Case report describing patients with hypertriglyceridemia-associated acute pancreatitis following SARS-CoV-2 infection. No treatment intervention is studied; this is a clinical observation of a post-COVID complication.

A case report of a severe COVID-19 pneumonia patient presenting with persistent shortness of breath and residual lung abnormalities 1.5 years post-discharge. The paper documents radiological findings and clinical presentation but does not test or evaluate any specific treatment intervention.

Case report of a 46-year-old female who developed glossopharyngeal neuralgia following COVID-19 infection, presenting with ear and pharyngeal pain. Carbamazepine was successfully used for neuropathic pain management, highlighting neurological complications as a long-COVID sequela.

Case report of a 45-year-old female presenting with chronic headache, giddiness, and lethargy 2 months post-COVID-19, diagnosed with empty sella syndrome and hyponatremia attributed to post-COVID hypothalamic-pituitary dysfunction. No treatment intervention was tested or evaluated; this is a descriptive case report only.

A case report of a 50-year-old female presenting with angina bullosa hemorrhagica-like oropharyngeal lesions and immune thrombocytopenia eight months post-COVID-19 infection. Symptomatic management with topical agents resulted in complete healing within seven days.

A case report of a 61-year-old patient with post-COVID multisystem inflammatory syndrome (MIS-A) presenting with rhabdomyolysis, acute kidney injury, and multiple organ involvement. The patient recovered with supportive care and intravenous immunoglobulin treatment, demonstrating a treatment response in this rare MIS-A presentation.

A case report of a 41-year-old male presenting with pulmonary embolism one month post-COVID-19 infection, diagnosed via lung perfusion scintigraphy and CT angiography. The paper highlights PE as a potential post-COVID sequela but does not test or evaluate any treatment intervention.

A case report describing a patient with spastic cerebellar ataxia that developed post-COVID-19 infection, presenting with acute generalized and multifocal ataxia onset within two weeks of infection. The paper documents clinical presentation, medical treatment, and rehabilitation outcomes, emphasizing the importance of early rehabilitation intervention for post-COVID neurological complications.

A case report describing central retinal artery occlusion with cilioretinal artery sparing in a 68-year-old female occurring 11 days after severe COVID-19 infection. The paper documents this as an additional ocular manifestation of post-acute COVID-19 syndrome but does not evaluate or test any intervention or treatment.

Case report of a single severe COVID-19 patient who developed post-COVID exercise intolerance and received a 6-week supervised home-based pulmonary rehabilitation program. Patient achieved functional independence in self-care activities and improved exercise tolerance.

Case report of a 41-year-old male who developed avascular necrosis of both femoral heads following COVID-19 infection, possibly related to corticosteroid treatment. The paper documents a long-term complication of COVID-19 but does not evaluate any treatment intervention for long COVID patients.

This case report describes the treatment of a 40-year-old male with post-COVID eosinophilia using Chatushashti prahari pippali, an Ayurvedic intervention. After 8 weeks of treatment, the patient achieved complete symptomatic relief with normalized eosinophil counts and no relapse during an 8-week follow-up period.

Case report of a patient presenting with bilateral anterior uveitis and multifocal serous retinopathy 22 days after COVID-19 infection, treated with intravenous and oral steroids. The paper describes the clinical presentation and resolution but does not evaluate a treatment intervention—it is a passive clinical observation of adverse manifestations.

Case report of a 64-year-old female presenting with Guillain-Barré syndrome (GBS) as a post-COVID complication following SARS-CoV-2 infection. Treatment with intravenous immunoglobulin resulted in improvement in respiratory failure and prevented need for mechanical ventilation.

Case report of a COPD patient who developed spontaneous pneumothorax 1 month after COVID-19 treatment. Describes a rare post-treatment complication rather than studying long COVID or evaluating a treatment intervention.

Case report of a 64-year-old female presenting with Guillain–Barré syndrome as a post-COVID complication following acute COVID-19 infection. Patient was treated with intravenous immunoglobulin infusion, resulting in improvement of respiratory failure and avoidance of mechanical ventilation.

This paper reports a case of hair loss in a long COVID patient in Saudi Arabia, noting that hair loss is reported by >25% of COVID-19 survivors as a persisting symptom. The paper is a case report describing a single clinical observation without any treatment intervention or control group.

A case report describing May-Thurner syndrome (compression of left iliofemoral vein) occurring in a 31-year-old female following COVID-19 infection. The paper presents clinical and imaging findings of this rare vascular complication but does not evaluate any treatment intervention.

Case report describing a single patient with postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome (POTS) diagnosed as a post-COVID-19 sequela. The paper documents diagnostic findings via autonomic function tests and discusses conservative management, but presents only one case without treatment evaluation or control group comparison.

Case report of a 57-year-old man diagnosed with post-COVID-19 Miller-Fisher syndrome (MFS) who showed resistance or minimal response to intravenous immunoglobulin (IVIG) treatment. The case describes clinical presentation, treatment challenges, and prognostic outcomes of this rare post-COVID neurological complication, highlighting the need for better understanding of disease pathophysiology and targeted treatments.

Case report of a patient with hereditary hemorrhagic telangiectasia who developed severe COVID-19 and post-COVID-19 persistence of Type 1 respiratory failure. Documents prophylactic anticoagulation with enoxaparin as a treatment intervention in this complex patient.

A case report describing marked cognitive impairment in a 63-year-old male following COVID-19 infection as part of long COVID sequelae. The paper presents a single clinical case rather than a systematic study or treatment intervention.

Case report of a post-COVID patient presenting with extensive pulmonary embolism, deep vein thrombosis, and thrombus in transit across a patent foramen ovale. The paper describes clinical presentation and imaging findings but does not evaluate any treatment intervention or compare outcomes across groups.

Case report describing a patient with persistent SARS-CoV-2 RNA and elevated inflammatory markers 12 weeks post-infection. The paper documents the clinical presentation and laboratory findings but does not evaluate any treatment or intervention.

Case report of opsoclonus-myoclonus syndrome in a pregnant patient with acute COVID-19 infection requiring emergency cesarean section. The paper documents a rare neurological complication during active infection, not a long COVID sequela.

A case report evaluating guided imagery as an adjunct to pulmonary rehabilitation for post-COVID-19 symptoms including anxiety, sleep disturbance, and quality of life via telerehabilitation. This is a single case report with no control group or systematic data collection, representing insufficient evidence for the trial dataset.

Case report of acute pulmonary nocardiosis occurring as a post-COVID infection complication. Describes clinical presentation, diagnostic findings, and treatment options for this rare opportunistic infection in long COVID patients.

A case report describing a post-COVID-19 patient presenting with tubercular pericardial effusion, suggesting latent TB reactivation following COVID-19 infection. The paper discusses potential immunomodulatory effects of COVID-19 and treatment drugs but does not evaluate any treatment intervention.

Case report of a 36-year-old patient who developed tumoural calcinosis of the biceps tendon 20 days post-COVID-19, presenting with severe shoulder pain and swelling. Conservative management with short-course NSAIDs resulted in complete symptom resolution after 4 weeks, demonstrating the effectiveness of this treatment approach for post-COVID musculoskeletal complications.

Case report of a 60-year-old male with post-COVID-19 diffuse viral myositis that progressed to bilateral avascular necrosis of the femoral heads, managed initially medically then surgically with bilateral hip replacement. This is a single clinical case without a control group or treatment intervention being tested.

Case report of a severe COVID-19 pneumonia patient presenting with persistent respiratory symptoms and lung abnormalities 12 months post-infection, treated with home oxygen supplementation and antifibrotic therapy for 3 months. Patient showed clinical and radiological improvement but continued to require oxygen during exertion and had progressive residual lung abnormalities consistent with pulmonary fibrosis.

A case report of a 30-year-old post-COVID-19 patient with cardiovascular endurance problems who received cardiac rehabilitation coaching. After 2 weeks of intervention, the patient showed moderate improvement in cardiovascular endurance.

Case report of a 69-year-old male who developed ANCA-associated vasculitis with crescentic glomerulonephritis two months after COVID-19 infection, presenting with acute kidney injury. Treatment with IV pulsed steroids followed by rituximab induction therapy led to renal function recovery and discontinuation of dialysis within three months.

Case report of accommodative insufficiency and refractive error emerging as a post-COVID-19 manifestation three weeks after infection. Describes diagnosis and management of accommodative dysfunction in a 22-year-old patient with a history of COVID-19 infection.

This case report documents a rare presentation of Rosai-Dorfman disease (RDD) as scleritis progressing to a scleral nodule in a patient with post-COVID-19 multisystem inflammatory syndrome. The patient was treated with methotrexate and showed no recurrence at 1-year follow-up.

Case report of a geriatric patient with post-COVID depression, psychomotor retardation, cognitive impairments, and suicidal ideation, with proposed pathophysiological mechanism involving neuroinflammation and reward pathway dysfunction. Treatment with sertraline (a sigma-1 receptor agonist) led to improvements in autonomic nervous system function, activity levels, and circadian rhythm.

Case report of a long COVID patient who developed secondary bacterial organizing pneumonia 7 weeks after SARS-CoV-2 recovery, caused by Klebsiella pneumoniae. Patient was successfully treated with antibiotics alone, demonstrating that early recognition and prompt antibiotic treatment can prevent prolonged corticosteroid use.

This case report describes clinically meaningful improvements in Long COVID symptoms following a remotely-delivered ketogenic metabolic therapy combined with group health coaching, nutritional interventions, circadian rhythm stabilization, and mindfulness practices. The paper reviews literature supporting ketogenic therapy and lifestyle interventions as strategies to address underlying mechanisms of Long COVID and recommends future research to evaluate these multimodal approaches.

This paper describes a single case of posterior reversible encephalopathy syndrome (PRES) during an acute COVID-19 ICU stay, not after recovery. It is about acute COVID-19 complications during hospitalization, not post-COVID syndrome or long COVID occurring after recovery.

Case report of a 24-year-old active duty male with post-COVID pancytopenia that revealed previously undiagnosed pernicious anemia. The paper describes the patient's presentation and response to standard treatment, but is a single case report without intervention data or comparison group.

This paper presents a single case report of a 33-year-old male with constrictive pericarditis potentially associated with COVID-19 or its vaccine. It is a case report/editorial discussing a rare manifestation rather than a treatment study.

This case report describes a 69-year-old male who developed concurrent Guillain-Barré syndrome and hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis following COVID-19 infection, representing post-COVID neurological and hematological complications. The patient was treated with intravenous immunoglobulin therapy, which produced a good clinical response.

Case report of a 25-year-old woman who developed neuromyelitis optica (NMO) following COVID-19 infection, presenting with progressive weakness and numbness. The paper describes clinical presentation, imaging findings, and NMO-IgG seropositivity but does not evaluate any treatment intervention or trial.

Case report of a post-COVID-19 patient who developed dermatomyositis with progressive muscle weakness weeks after initial myalgia diagnosis. Patient responded favorably to steroid treatment, demonstrating a potential autoimmune complication and treatment response in post-COVID sequelae.

A case report of a 90-year-old patient who developed hypersomnia after COVID-19 and was treated with donepezil, an acetylcholinesterase inhibitor. The treatment resulted in increased wakefulness and improvement in Epworth sleepiness scale scores.

This case report describes a 45-year-old male who developed autoimmune hepatitis-primary biliary cholangitis overlap syndrome two weeks after mild SARS-CoV-2 infection, presenting with fatigue, jaundice, elevated liver enzymes, and acute kidney injury. The patient was treated with prednisone, azathioprine, and ursodeoxycholic acid, with satisfactory biochemical response following the addition of the latter two agents.

Case report of a 24-year-old male with recurrent oral erythema multiforme-like lesions following COVID-19 infection, treated with topical preparations and oral prednisolone with complete healing by day 10. The second episode occurring 5 months later suggests persistent long-term effects of COVID-19 on oral mucosa in certain patients.

Case report of a 59-year-old patient with bifacial weakness and paraesthesia (variant of Guillain-Barré syndrome) occurring 1 month after SARS-CoV-2 infection, treated with intravenous immunoglobulin therapy. The patient showed prompt clinical improvement after 5 days of treatment, suggesting potential post-COVID neurological complications.

A case study evaluating pulmonary physiotherapy effectiveness in a 62-year-old male patient with post-COVID-19 respiratory syndrome. The patient underwent functional assessments (Six-Minute Walking Test, Borg scale, muscle strength testing) before and after physiotherapy, demonstrating that rehabilitation improved exercise capacity and respiratory sequelae.

Case report of a 33-year-old male who developed post-COVID-19 myelitis (Brown-Séquard syndrome) six weeks after initial SARS-CoV-2 infection, presenting with progressive lower limb weakness and sensory changes. Patient received methylprednisolone treatment and showed significant clinical and radiological improvement within one month.

Case report describing a patient who developed autoimmune adrenal gland failure with infarction as a late complication of COVID-19. The paper documents clinical presentation and discusses adrenal insufficiency as a post-COVID sequela but does not evaluate any treatment intervention or compare treatment outcomes.

This is a case report describing post-COVID syndrome in an individual patient, documenting persistent symptoms and clinical findings. It is a descriptive case report without any treatment intervention or systematic study design.

Clinical case report describing aseptic necrosis of joints and tubular bones as a rare complication of post-COVID syndrome in Uzbekistan. The paper presents a single case observation without treatment intervention or comparative analysis.

A case study evaluating an Ayurvedic treatment protocol (Nasya therapy combined with herbal formulations) for post-COVID chronic bronchitis in a 27-year-old female patient. Treatment resulted in subjective symptom relief and improved pulmonary function measurements (FEV1, FVC).

Case report of a patient presenting with anterior uveitis in the post-COVID period in Pakistan. The paper describes clinical investigation and management of the patient but does not study a treatment intervention or therapeutic outcome.

A clinical case report of an elderly long COVID patient who developed atrial fibrillation refractory to antiarrhythmic therapy. The paper describes risk factors and laboratory findings associated with this patient's post-COVID complications rather than evaluating a treatment intervention.

Case report of a patient with chronic heart failure secondary to myocarditis who experienced decompensation following COVID-19 infection. Documents clinical progression over six months and adjustments to drug and non-drug therapy, but is a single case observation without intervention testing or control group.

A case study of a 42-year-old female with post-COVID lung fibrosis treated with Ayurvedic medications including Sameer pannag rasa, yashtimadhu churn, and other herbal preparations. The patient reportedly recovered completely following treatment.

Case report of a 44-year-old female who developed spinal cord dysfunction (lower-limb paralysis) two weeks after COVID-19 pneumonia resolution. The paper describes clinical presentation and investigations but does not report any treatment intervention or outcomes.

A case report of a 50-year-old male with post-COVID arthralgia treated with Ayurvedic interventions (Haritakyadi yoga followed by Amalaki Rasayana) over 30 days. Treatment resulted in reduced arthralgia symptoms, improved energy levels, and enhanced well-being scores on the WHO well-being index and six-minute walk test.

Case report describing Harlequin Syndrome in a young adult with multi-system inflammatory syndrome (MIS) following COVID-19 infection. The paper presents a single clinical case rather than a treatment trial or long COVID intervention study.

This case report describes a 38-year-old male presenting with an occult rib fracture 3 weeks post-COVID-19, demonstrating cough-induced rib fracture as a rare complication of long COVID. The patient was successfully treated conservatively with pain control, breathing exercises, and medications, with complete resolution at 8-week follow-up, while highlighting ultrasound as an effective diagnostic modality for detecting occult rib fractures in primary care settings.

A case report describing a 22-year-old female with 14-month long COVID who recovered from ME-like symptoms after oral minocycline treatment. The paper proposes minocycline as a potential first-line therapy for long COVID based on its anti-inflammatory and neuroprotective properties, though the authors acknowledge a large-scale trial is needed.

A single case report describing a 63-year-old female with unilateral upper lip numbness and pain following COVID-19, with neuroimaging showing acute sinusitis inflammation and presumed infraorbital nerve neuropraxia. This is a descriptive case report with no treatment intervention or control group.

This case report describes a 36-year-old male with warm autoimmune hemolytic anemia (WAIHA) presenting three months after COVID-19 infection as a late manifestation of post-COVID syndrome. The patient demonstrated clinical improvement following rituximab treatment after initial steroid resistance, highlighting autoimmune sequelae as a complication requiring post-COVID monitoring.

A case study of one post-COVID-19 autoimmune encephalitis patient comparing diffusion tensor imaging (DTI) to standard MRI, showing DTI's superior sensitivity in detecting early white matter changes. This is a single case report without treatment intervention or control group design.

A case report of a 62-year-old male who developed Guillain-Barré Syndrome following COVID-19 recovery, with a notably longer latent period than previously reported cases. The paper discusses clinical management and learning points but presents no intervention or treatment evaluation.

Case report describing the use of pulsed radiofrequency treatment for post-COVID occipital neuralgia in patients experiencing neuropathic pain following SARS-CoV-2 infection. The authors present this intervention as an effective therapeutic option for reducing symptoms and improving quality of life in refractory cases.

Case report of a COVID-19 patient who developed post-intubation bilateral vocal fold granulomas, a laryngeal complication following ARDS and mechanical ventilation. The authors highlight the need for clinical preparedness and follow-up care including breathing exercises and speech therapy for patients recovering from intubation.

A case report describing a 36-year-old female patient who developed pulmonary artery thrombosis 16 days after acute COVID-19 infection and was treated with Rivaroxaban anticoagulation. The author proposes that energy deficiency in internal organs (assessed via radiesthesia) predisposes to thrombotic complications post-COVID.

A case report describing occupational therapy evaluation and treatment approaches for a patient with long COVID symptoms in an outpatient setting. The paper demonstrates evidence-based occupational therapy strategies and associated outcomes for managing post-COVID syndrome.

This paper reports a single case of multisystem inflammatory syndrome in children (MIS-C) occurring after SARS-CoV-2 infection, presenting with Kawasaki-like features. The case describes acute presentation and treatment during hospitalization, not a study of long COVID sequelae or persistent symptoms weeks/months after infection.

A case study evaluating a 12-week home-based respiratory rehabilitation program (aerobic exercises, muscle strengthening, breathing exercises, education) in a single long COVID patient. The patient showed improvements across multiple outcomes including quality of life, anxiety/depression, dyspnea, aerobic capacity, and functional capacity at 6 and 12 weeks.

A case report of a 5-year-old child with post-COVID multisystem inflammatory syndrome (MIS) presenting with cardiac, gastrointestinal, and psychiatric complications including self-injurious behavior leading to jaw osteomyelitis. This is a single case report documenting clinical manifestations during acute post-COVID MIS treatment, not a study of a treatment intervention for long COVID.

Case report of a 41-year-old woman presenting with Guillain-Barré syndrome (GBS) as a complication of COVID-19. The paper discusses supportive care and treatment options (IV immunoglobulin vs plasmapheresis) but does not evaluate an intervention in a systematic way—it is a single case report.

A case study of one long COVID patient who recovered after 3.5 years using a 'soft trial approach' targeting autonomic nervous system dysfunction. The paper presents a single patient narrative without a formal study design or control group.

Case report of anomic aphasia occurring 10 weeks after SARS-CoV-2 infection in a single patient, with spontaneous resolution by week 14. Discusses neurological manifestations of post-COVID syndrome related to blood-brain barrier dysfunction and neuroinflammation.

Case report of a 53-year-old patient presenting with depressive and catatonic symptoms 8 weeks post-COVID-19 recovery, successfully treated with lorazepam 1 mg. The case illustrates catatonia as a potential neuropsychiatric manifestation of post-COVID-19 syndrome.

A pediatric case report of autoimmune sclerosing cholangitis diagnosed 2 months after SARS-CoV-2 infection, suggesting a potential post-viral autoimmune trigger. The paper presents one case and calls for further study of autoimmune liver diseases potentially associated with COVID-19, but does not describe a treatment intervention or study long COVID as its primary focus.

This paper describes the clinical course and complications of COVID-19 in children, focusing on identifying early manifestations and risk factors for long-term complications. It is a descriptive case study and clinical review, not a treatment intervention trial, so it does not meet inclusion criteria for the meta-analysis.

A case report of a 38-year-old post-COVID patient who received an 8-week supervised home-based pulmonary rehabilitation program. The intervention resulted in improvements in oxygen saturation, walking distance, functional status, quality of life, and mental health outcomes.

Case report of physiotherapy intervention for a post-COVID-19 patient presenting with prolonged symptoms including dyspnea, chest pain, and musculoskeletal complaints. Eight sessions of physiotherapy using infrared, breathing exercises, and diaphragmatic breathing resulted in reduced dyspnea (Borg scale) and improved functional capacity (mMRC and six-minute walk test).

Case report of a 41-year-old male presenting with syncope triggered by severe cough in the post-acute phase of COVID-19 (2 weeks post-infection). Patient was treated with a multimodal intervention including proton-pump inhibitors, antimuscarinic agents, gabapentin, antibiotics, and steroids, resulting in complete resolution of syncopal cough episodes.

Case report of a 59-year-old man with post-acute COVID-19 syndrome presenting with persistent respiratory symptoms, fatigue, and functional limitations 3 months after critical COVID-19 requiring ICU admission and mechanical ventilation. The paper describes clinical features and general management approaches (symptomatic treatment, rehabilitation, psychotherapy) but does not evaluate a specific treatment intervention.

Case report of a 28-year-old female who developed atypical Cogan's syndrome (rare autoimmune disorder with ocular inflammation and vestibulocochlear dysfunction) one month after COVID-19 infection, with additional neurological involvement including meningitis. The patient received corticosteroid therapy with partial response, ultimately requiring cochlear implants for hearing loss.

Case report of a 68-year-old long COVID patient treated with therapeutic plasma exchange (TPE), showing clinical improvement and return to normal activities. Mechanistic analysis revealed shifts in immune markers toward tissue repair and reduced inflammatory proteins, suggesting TPE may have therapeutic potential for long COVID.

Clinical case report of a patient with bladder cancer diagnosed four months after COVID-19 infection, highlighting the diagnostic challenge of distinguishing long COVID symptoms (asthenia, fatigue) from paraneoplastic syndrome. The paper discusses the interaction between post-COVID manifestations and underlying malignancy but presents no treatment intervention or outcomes data.

Case report of a 28-year-old female who developed atypical Cogan's syndrome (rare autoimmune disorder with ocular inflammation, vestibulocochlear dysfunction, and vasculitis) one month following COVID-19 infection. The patient received corticosteroid therapy with initial improvement in ophthalmological symptoms, though she progressed to complete deafness and developed lymphocytic meningitis requiring treatment.

This case report describes the clinical management and treatment of a patient with long-term post-COVID syndrome complicated by severe interstitial lung changes following severe acute COVID-19 infection. The paper documents the patient's clinical course, diagnostic findings, and therapeutic interventions over the follow-up period.

A case report describing a young male patient who developed transverse myelitis following confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection, presenting with sensory and motor losses in lower limbs and sphincter dysfunction. The paper documents this post-COVID neurological complication but is a single case report without treatment evaluation or intervention testing.

Case report of a 71-year-old patient with long COVID who developed myasthenia gravis and was treated with plasmapheresis. Demonstrates treatment of a post-COVID neurological complication with symptom relief achieved through plasma exchange therapy.

This case report describes the outcomes of nutritional therapy for a single post-COVID patient in a Home Care Program, including supplementation with arginine, proline, vitamins, and minerals. Over 70 days, the patient achieved nutritional status improvement, 6 kg weight gain, and enhanced capacity for physical therapy and daily activities.

Case report of a 5-month-old infant presenting with post-COVID pulmonary complications (fibro-atelectatic changes) 1 month after severe acute COVID-19 infection. Describes clinical presentation and imaging findings but does not evaluate or test any specific treatment intervention.

Case report of a 61-year-old patient with persistent hypoxemia and dyspnea following acute COVID-19 pneumonia treated with hyperbaric oxygen therapy (HBOT). Significant clinical improvement was observed after 20 HBOT sessions, suggesting potential therapeutic benefit for post-COVID hypoxemia.

This paper presents a single clinical case of a patient who developed Brugada-like ECG changes as a delayed complication after COVID-19 recovery. It is a case report documenting a rare cardiac manifestation of long-term COVID-19 sequelae, not a treatment study.

Case series evaluating myoreflex therapy as a treatment for post-acute sequelae of COVID-19 (PASC) patients. Addresses multiple PASC symptoms including cognitive impairment, fatigue, dyspnea, and musculoskeletal pain.

A case study describing the application of a lightning process mind-body intervention for long COVID-19 patients. The authors suggest that early mind-body treatment may be effective for long COVID, particularly when patients recognize the condition as having a mind-body component amenable to improvement.

Case report of a 29-year-old male with post-COVID thromboembolic complications (pulmonary embolism and right atrial thrombus) despite prior anticoagulation therapy. The paper discusses the need to reconsider anticoagulation duration in post-COVID patients but does not evaluate or test any specific intervention.

Case report of a single patient examining serum metabolic profile changes two years before and during recovery from COVID-19 infection using NMR spectroscopy. Identified decreased metabolites involved in multiple metabolic pathways (TCA cycle, fatty acid synthesis, steroid hormone biosynthesis) during post-infection recovery.

A case report describing spontaneous superficial temporal artery hemorrhage in a patient three months post-COVID-19 infection, attributed to autonomic dysfunction and endothelial changes. The paper documents clinical presentation and management of a single case of post-COVID vascular complication without any intervention trial or treatment evaluation.

A case report describing QT prolongation in a long COVID patient with pre-existing borderline QT interval not on antiviral medications, suggesting independent disease effect on cardiac conduction. This is a single case report with no intervention or treatment evaluation.

Case report of acute interstitial pneumonia with secondary bacterial infection occurring two weeks after SARS-CoV-2 infection in a 64-year-old patient. Describes acute phase respiratory complications during active COVID-19, not long COVID sequelae.

A case report describing thrombosis occurring in a middle-aged female following recent SARS-CoV-2 infection, illustrating a potential long COVID complication. The paper documents clinical presentation of a post-acute sequela but does not evaluate any treatment intervention.

Case report describing a patient who developed Guillain Barré syndrome following COVID-19 with interstitial lung damage. This is a single case observation without any treatment intervention or outcome data.

Case report of a single 32-year-old patient with long COVID who underwent a 28-day hybrid water fast with incorporated dry fasting periods, resulting in complete symptom resolution that has persisted for four years. The authors propose that extended hybrid water fasting may provide immune system benefits for treating the multisystemic nature of long COVID, though evidence is limited to this single case.

A case report of a 71-year-old female who developed ischemic sclerosing cholangitis as a post-COVID-19 complication during hospitalization for severe pneumonia. She was treated with ursodeoxycholic acid and bezafibrate, but developed secondary cirrhosis with unfavorable clinical outcomes.

Case study of a 44-year-old woman with long COVID examining cognitive-linguistic difficulties including memory impairment, reduced discourse informativeness, and verbal fluency deficits. Patient showed moderate improvement over six months but insufficient recovery to return to work, with persistent cognitive-linguistic symptoms identified as the most troubling long-term consequence.

A clinical case report of a 25-year-old patient with post-COVID syndrome presenting with neurological symptoms, immune dysfunction, and reactive arthritis 2 weeks after acute COVID-19 recovery. Treatment with Erbisol immunocorrection therapy resulted in symptom resolution and normalization of immunological parameters by day 25.

This case report documents a 76-year-old male patient who developed ANCA-negative pauci-immune crescentic glomerulonephritis as a complication of long COVID, presenting with leg swelling, shortness of breath, and fatigue. The patient was treated with medications and dialysis, representing what the authors believe to be the first reported case of this specific renal complication associated with long COVID.

A case report of a 74-year-old Nigerian woman who developed post-COVID-19 fibrotic interstitial lung disease following severe COVID-19 pneumonia, treated with corticosteroids, anticoagulants, antivirals, and supportive care. The case demonstrates long-term pulmonary complications including restrictive disease and residual breathlessness, highlighting the need for post-COVID clinical surveillance.

A clinical case report of post-COVID amiostatic syndrome associated with autoimmune anti-NMDAR encephalitis with basal ganglia involvement. The paper demonstrates clinical efficacy of amantadine (NMDA receptor antagonist) treatment and emphasizes the importance of early diagnosis and intervention for post-COVID autoimmune encephalitis.

This paper describes a single clinical case of AV nodal re-entry tachycardia recurrence after radiofrequency ablation in a patient with post-COVID syndrome. It is a case report with no treatment intervention or trial design, only clinical observation and discussion of mechanisms.

A case report of a 56-year-old male who developed polyneuropathy 90 days after acute COVID-19 infection, presenting with progressive paresthesia in feet, hands, and reduced reflexes. The patient was treated with gabapentin and physical therapy, showing partial improvement in symptoms.

Paper describes the use of Longidase, an enzyme preparation, for treating post-COVID pneumonia. The abstract focuses on diagnostic imaging approaches (CT) for COVID-19 and post-covid syndrome without presenting results or study findings, indicating this is a protocol or descriptive piece rather than a completed study.

Case report of a 67-year-old man presenting with ataxic syndrome and neurological symptoms occurring one month after COVID-19 infection, characterized by progressive dysesthesia, hypotonicity, and ataxia. Patient was treated with B12 vitamin replacement and achieved favorable clinical recovery within two weeks, highlighting the importance of considering B12 deficiency and post-viral atypical manifestations in post-COVID neurological presentations.

A case report of a 45-year-old woman who developed Stiff Person Syndrome and lumbosacral plexopathy as an autoimmune neurological complication following SARS-CoV-2 infection. The patient was treated with methylprednisolone and immunoglobulin infusion with partial improvement, representing a rare post-COVID neurological manifestation.

Case report of a 52-year-old woman with non-Hodgkin's lymphoma who experienced recurrent post-COVID symptoms including fatigue, dyspnea, cough, and anorexia despite initial recovery from acute SARS-CoV-2 infection. The study documents prolonged viral shedding and symptom persistence in an immunocompromised patient but presents no treatment intervention or outcomes.

A case report of a 15-year-old who developed Kleine-Levin syndrome (intermittent hypersomnia with behavioral disturbances) following mild COVID-19 infection. Treatment with lithium and clarithromycin during acute episodes reduced symptom severity and episode duration, suggesting potential therapeutic mechanisms for post-COVID neurological complications.

A case report of a 32-year-old male who developed new-onset refractory status epilepticus (NORSE) one week after acute COVID-19 infection, possibly associated with steroid-responsive encephalitis and thyroid autoimmunity. The patient was successfully treated with immunotherapy (IVIG and methylprednisolone), antiseizure medications, and anesthetic agents (ketamine, propofol, midazolam), achieving seizure control and discharge without sequelae.

A case report of a 32-year-old male who developed long COVID symptoms following severe acute COVID-19 and reinfection, presenting with peripheral sensorimotor axonal polyneuropathy affecting multiple limbs. The paper documents clinical presentation and electroneuromyographic findings but does not evaluate any treatment intervention.

Case report of a 19-year-old female who developed subacute thyroiditis (SAT) four months after SARS-CoV-2 infection, presenting with prolonged fatigue, weight loss, and thyroid dysfunction. The paper describes a single case of post-COVID thyroid complications without intervention or treatment evaluation.

A case report describing a patient who developed healthcare-associated infective endocarditis 10 days after discharge from COVID-19 hospitalization. The paper documents a single case of late-onset cardiac infection as a long-term complication of COVID-19, without describing any treatment intervention or comparative analysis.

A case report of a post-COVID-19 myelitis patient treated with plasmapheresis after initial methylprednisolone therapy failed. The patient showed notable clinical improvement three months post-treatment, with muscle strength improving from 2/5 to 4/5 bilaterally and resolution of sensory and urinary symptoms.

Case report of an 8-year-old with acute appendicitis and histological evidence of microvascular injury (endarteritis obliterans) three months after COVID-19 infection. Documents a potential post-COVID complication affecting the gastrointestinal tract but does not evaluate any treatment intervention.

This case report describes the application of osteopathic manipulative treatment (OMT) to a post-COVID-19 patient presenting with anosmia and ageusia (loss of smell and taste). The patient regained normal sense of smell and taste 4 days after initial OMT treatment, suggesting potential benefit of this approach for acute post-COVID chemosensory dysfunction.

Case report of a 32-year-old male with severe COVID-19 pneumonia who developed post-COVID lung fibrosis (PCLF) and was treated with remdesivir, methylprednisolone, and the antifibrotic nintedanib, along with 12 weeks of home oxygen therapy. At one-year follow-up, chest imaging showed residual sequelae but no cardiopulmonary or exercise performance impact, demonstrating clinical improvement with treatment.

This case report describes post-COVID telogen effluvium (hair loss) in a 6-year-old child that resolved spontaneously over 8 months. While the symptom occurred after SARS-CoV-2 infection, it is a transient, self-limiting dermatological manifestation rather than long COVID; the paper does not study treatment and merely documents natural resolution.

Case report of acute pericarditis with pericardial effusion occurring one month after COVID-19 infection in a 44-year-old patient, treated with ibuprofen and colchicine.
